7 free things to do in Baltimore

1️⃣Ride the Charm City Circulator

3️⃣Walked across to the @thewaltersartmuseum which is full of history and art 
4️⃣Hopped back on the Purple line to the famous Graffiti Alley which is home of local graffiti artist and the perfect backdrop for photos
5️⃣Took the orange line over to the Baltimore’s Inner Harbor @waterfrontpartnership which is always having something fun happening
6️⃣Walked to @rashfieldpark which is home to a nice playground 
7️⃣Walked over to Federal Hill which is a nice place to have lunch, enjoy views or play on the playground. @Recnpark

This small Black woman-owned business is serving Southern/soul food inside a commercial/ghost kitchen called The La Chow. 

Chef T’s food really shines because of the texture, which is why I recommend picking up though delivery is also available.

Here’s what we tried:

🦀Chesapeake Eggrolls – These were so good! Big portion with that classic Maryland seafood seasoning. I loved how crispy the egg roll wrap was.

🥗 Kale Caesar – To know me is to know I eat some variation of a Caesar salad multiple times a week 😂. I prefer romaine lettuce, but this was a solid kale Caesar. I just wished the dressing had a bit more tartness.

🧀 Oxtail Mac – Creamy, mild mac & cheese topped with tender, savory, bold oxtail. Such a delicious combo!

🍗 Turkey Leg – I’ve enjoyed her turkey wings/legs for years, and they’re always super tender. Expect them to be cured (a little salty), similar to what you’d get at a carnival or fair.

🥬 Cabbage & Kale – Seasoned with turmeric, which was unique and tasty.

🥤 Half & Half – A Baltimore classic!

Business hours are Wednesday–Saturday , 4 PM to 9 PM.

googleReviews: This food is called Pho Noodles with Roast Beef. It tastes delicious to me because it's just a taste with high-quality ingredients along with summer rolls. The service is very quick.

Disclaimer
As someone who's of Vietnamese descent and lives in Southern California (home to the most Vietnamese outside of Vietnam), I have had some of the best pho in North America. I knew going in that having pho anywhere else would probably be disappointing, but I always hope for a pleasant surprise.

The Food:
I can only comment on what I ordered: pho dac biet (special combo pho with rare steak slices, well-done brisket, flank tendon, and and tripe). Taste wise it was ... alright. The noodles were standard, the meats were good, and the tendon was delicious. The problem was that the broth was kinda bland, lacking the delicate mix of herbs and seasonings that a good bowl of pho should have. And anyone who enjoys noodle soups knows that if the broth doesn't cut it, the whole meal suffers. Don't get me wrong, the other pho ingredients were quality, but the bland broth was a let down.

The Cost:
The bigger letdown were the prices, which had me saying, "What the pho?!" My combo bowl was $27. That would be an outrageous price for pho in Southern California (where prices have skyrocketed), so you could imagine my "sticker shock." And the costs for the other entrees ranged from $14 to $20. While the portions were large, I'm not sure the quality justified the price.

The Drink:
I had a caphe sua da (or Vietnamese iced coffee) and was, again, not  impressed. It tasted like it came from either a concentrate or instant coffee instead of being made in a phin, a type of slow-drip metal filter, before the condensed milk was added. Again, not a bad coffee, but the price didn't justify the average taste.

The Service:
The two employees were fast and friendly. They didn't check on us at all after delivering the food (standard operating procedure for most Asian restaurants), but the fact that they were polite and seemed like they cared is a big plus for a Vietnamese establishment.

The Atmosphere:
The restaurant was clean, spacious, and modern. Meanwhile, the bathroom was shockingly decent and well stocked. Again, two aspects that were a pleasant surprise for a Vietnamese restaurant.

The Conclusion:
If you're new to pho and want to be impressed, don't go here. If you're familiar with pho, need a quick fix, and don't mind paying a premium, this place will do.

I don’t think I would get it again as I have had brisket that isn’t as fatty. I have had their ribs once and found the flavor to be good but fatty as well. The mushroom gravy and rice had a lot of thyme in it, but with less thyme and a few other tweaks, could be good. The mac and cheese is tasty.

I can see myself returning, but sticking to specific menu items. Great service!
customer_insights: Heritage Smokehouse offers a casual dining experience with a focus on smoked meats, particularly ribs and brisket. While the service is consistently praised, some menu items can be hit or miss, especially regarding the fattiness of certain meats. Overall, it's a solid choice for a laid-back meal, especially for groups looking to enjoy barbecue.

address: 1601 Union Ave, Baltimore, MD 21211, USA
googleReviews:
Places show their true colors when things go awry. My pickup order got messed up tonight. Blue pit made it right, right away, no questions asked. And they were busy.

Customer service matters. Not only is the bbq outstanding, so are the people that work there.

Make sure you give it a try. It won’t disappoint.

I’m from the Carolinas, so I’ve been in search of BBQ in the Baltimore area and Blue Pit didn’t disappoint! I recommend getting one of the meat platters so you can try a good mix of the meat and sides 😁 The brisket was a favorite! The mac and cheese was super creamy and the baked beans were not too sweet, great tangy/savory taste! (PS you’ve got to try all their different BBQ sauces, the coffee one was great w the mac and cheese). We’ll be back, thx!!

✨ A Hidden Gem for Celebrations & Soul Food! ✨
We recently celebrated my son’s first birthday here, and I honestly couldn’t have asked for a better experience! From the moment we arrived, everything was beautifully organized and ready to go, we reserved the upstairs space, and it felt private, welcoming, and perfect for our family gathering. The food was incredible… fresh, flavorful, and a hit with every guest (the plates stayed full and the compliments didn’t stop!). But what truly set this place apart was the exceptional service. Cara, the manager, went above and beyond for us. Her kindness, clear communication, and attention to detail made the entire process smooth and stress-free. She ensured every part of our experience was handled with care, and it genuinely meant so much to us.

If you’re looking for a place that feels like good vibes, great food, and even better people, this is it. I’ll be recommending The BBQ Pit to all my friends and family, not just for parties but for any excuse to stop by and enjoy the amazing atmosphere. We’ll definitely be back!

Thank you again for helping us create such a memorable day. 🧡

We got married at the American Visionary Art Museum in October 2025, and Blue Pit BBQ catered our wedding.  Blue Pit's food is top notch - don't sleep on the potato salad, the coleslaw, and the coffee BBQ sauce.  Their cocktails are great and the atmosphere at their restaurant is the perfect laid back and friendly vibe.  Both indoors and outdoors are kid friendly.  Cara, the owner, is phenomenal, and was so detail oriented and helpful throughout the entire planning process.  I can't say enough great things about Blue Pit!

Honestly, i think this place has gone downhill, it was not the best bbq to begin with in the area. I ordered food to go, immediately when i looked at the meat it looked old and dry like a day old or even more bbq. The brisket was decent, the ribs trash, hard and zero flavor and tough.. i will throw it away for sure, the best thing was the pickles. Not even wasting my time to go here anymore, will head on to 83 to get better bbq at Andy Nelsons.
customer_insights: Blue Pit BBQ is a beloved casual dining spot in Baltimore known for its outstanding BBQ and exceptional customer service. While it has received praise for its flavorful meats and welcoming atmosphere, some reviews indicate inconsistency in food quality. It's a great choice for gatherings and celebrations, making it a popular spot for families and groups.

address: 3701 Boston St, Baltimore, MD 21224, USA
googleReviews: This was the best food I have had in a very long time!!  Let me tell y’all about the cleanliness of the store, immaculate. The bathrooms, very clean. The waitress and staff, the friendliest. The manager was a wonderful person. He came to every table to see if everyone’s food was to their satisfaction, and if they needed anything else. WOW!!!  The food, the food, the food!  The yard bird was delicious. The brisket and turkey were delicious.  Macaroni and cheese and greens, delicious. The sandwiches and fries were delicious, and the strawberry shortcake dessert was the grand finale!  We washed it all down with half and half (lemonade and iced tea blend).  We will be back. My daughter had the ribs and string beans, she loved it!  Oh yeah, the bbq sauces! 🥰
Got the three meat sampler. Brisket, Ribs, and classic sausage. Side of Greenbeans. Also I got the Bread pudding. Everything was phenomenal as always.

jermaine, courtney and cora (apology for any misspelling of the names) were GREAT! I took my mom there for the first time and we were really impressed the food was spectacular, literally everything was good and the customer service was off the walls, will be going back very soon. You will not be disappointed! they made everything with LOVE and Cora throughly explained the menu to us plus helped with our questions. Would rate 600 stars if i could

I visit this location often and iv never had a bad experience until tonight . Not sure if it was due to the time or not but I may not return to this location after this . I ordered the brisket which is the only entree i purchase at Mission BBQ and I always get moist , I even order extra meat .

When the young lady called me to pick up my meal the brisket was dry and they just gave me pieces of meat . I have never had this happen to me before , again I’m not sure if it was due to it being the end of the night or not but that’s still unacceptable. My meal cost me close to $30 and it’s now trash .

When I asked the young lady about the meat and moisture, she suggested that juice may help so she gave me some in a small container to pour it over the meat. I’m just over all pissed and I plan to travel to another mission bbq if I ever buy anymore.

It’s 9/19 /2025 and it’s 8:40pm . I feel like they gave me that food in that condition because whatever food was left over they kept for themselves . Not to mention the profanity that was used with the talking & jokes amongst each other at the front  . It was only one person who used the word but even still I was mind blown because this has never happened & I assume it depends which manager is there and time .

The person who took my order was kind ❤️  This messed up my dinner / night & I’m Disappointed overall.

The weekend shift where I work chooses Missions of Canton for our Sunday lunch about one or twice a month. We all consider this place a treat. My favorite is the pulled chicken while my coworkers lean towards the brisket. Whatever we have chosen over the past few years has always been consistent. The food has never been dry but always scrumptious and moist and flavorful. I hope you will treat yourself to Missions. Just an overall great establishment.
customer_insights: MISSION BBQ in Baltimore is praised for its delicious barbecue offerings, friendly staff, and clean environment. While most reviews highlight the quality of food and service, there are occasional concerns about consistency, particularly with specific menu items during late hours.

address: 720 Mapleton Ave, Baltimore, MD 21205, USA
googleReviews:
This place was great.  We were passing through from Philly to Virginia and grabbed dinner.  We don’t have any charcoal type places where we’re from.

The charcoal flavor comes through and it was delicious.  The girlfriend got the roast beef platter (beef over fries smothered in gravy), I got the habit sandwich (beef, Turkey, ham and cheese).
.
Everything was delicious, fast service on a Friday night at 6pm

Lives up to the hype. Better than I thought it would be. Cooked perfect medium rare. A taste thrill if you like BBQ. The bun is fresh, moist and flavorful. Tasty horseradish sauce. Green beans are unique and good if you like stewed tomatoes like I do. Unique tasty baked beans. Good Mac N Cheese. Good fries - I would order the fries well done or extra crispy. Good Mac salad. New location is nice. Hope to get back here.

We had been wanting to try them for quite some time, but since we live a few states away, we just haven't. We were finally in the area and it was a must have. Man did it not disappoint! The beef is super tender and flavorful. The sausage has a little heat. The turkey was full of smokey flavor. The fries were hot and crispy. Horseradish sauce was just right. The kids loved theirs too. All in, it was wonderful and we would not hesitate to eat here again!

Loved everything about this place. Location, customer service, and especially the food!!! Got a pork bbq sandwich, baked beans, and some banana pudding!! It’s all 12/10!! Flavorful and delicious. The bread on the pork sandwich was perfection! I hate hard bread on sandwiches and this was soft and just heavenly.

My wife and I stopped in and were pleasantly surprised by how good the food was. As truck drivers, we’re not in the area often, but since we were parked nearby, we decided to give it a try for dinner. (There’s enough parking on the road next to the restaurant for a bobtail, and it’s two-hour parking.)

I ordered the Triple D, and my wife had The Raven. Since it was our first visit, I asked the staff for recommendations—and I couldn’t have been happier with their suggestions. I love that they ask how you’d like your beef cooked (medium rare for me), which is a unique and cool touch. I added pickles, onions, and tiger sauce to mine, and it was absolutely delicious!

The food was so good that we went back the next day for lunch before heading out to pick up a load. If I’m ever in—or even near—the area again, I’ll definitely be back.
customer_insights: Chaps Pit Beef Baltimore is renowned for its flavorful smoked meats and casual atmosphere, making it a popular stop for both locals and travelers. The quick service and delicious offerings, including their signature beef sandwiches and sides, create a satisfying dining experience.

venueName: Smoke-N-Wheels BBQ (I & S Food Solutions LLC)
address: 10 N Calvert St Suite 102, Baltimore, MD 21202, USA
googleReviews: They made my wife wait over twenty minutes to get the brisket platter. It cost 25 dollars! And had very small portions. The fries were cold, the Mac and cheese was flavorless, and the brisket was more gristle than not. If this cost 5 dollars it would have been acceptable. The fries were good and well seasoned but would have been better had they not been cold. Cafeteria quality food for gourmet prices.
Smackin Mac and cheese 🤦🏾‍♂️ 3 thumbs down. No cheese at all!! It was pretty much like burnt buttered noodles. Beans were so-so. Tastes like bush’s to me. Ribs were pretty good tho. Lol.
My wife and I Spent the day with family in Maryland for Breast Cancer Awareness Month. Carl and Gary Phyllis and Kamela. Great food. I had the Brisket and fries. My wife had Brisket Quesadilla

I always enjoy going to Smoke And Wheels barbecue. The staff is outstanding, the food unbelievably wonderful and I give it five stars in every category. I especially like the love boat, which is the mac & cheese with different toppings and sauce and brisket.  I have gone in and most frequently. I do the takeout or Delivery. Each option is super Everyone is very accommodating and makes you feel welcome. It works well for me.

THIS REVIEW IS LONGGGGGG overdue. i came in on a night FRESH out of class and was greeted promptly by the owner and chef who made me knowledgeable about the menu and their business hours ! i purchased the brisket soul bowl with mac and cheese as my base and let me tell you… CHEFS KISS — 1000/10. i also had some gumbo greens, sweet potatoes, & a lovely strawberry cake. i cant get over this place. if i can give them 100 stars i would! please come visit them if you haven’t b
customer_insights: Smoke-N-Wheels BBQ offers a casual dining experience with a focus on barbecue dishes. While some customers praise the brisket and ribs, there are mixed reviews regarding portion sizes and food quality, particularly for sides like mac and cheese. The venue is suitable for casual gatherings and takeout, making it a good spot for a laid-back meal.

address: 11950 Falls Rd, Cockeysville, MD 21030, USA
googleReviews:
One of Baltimore County’s hidden gems. Seriously good pit meats served without frills in an old service station on Falls Rd. No, I take that back, they always hand a flower to the ladies, which is very sweet and definitely a frill.

Their sandwiches are huge. Tasty. Great quality. I’ve never been disappointed with their ham, turkey and roast beef. The sandwiches are meaty enough that a half will satisfy if you split it with a friend. My husband and I took an order of ribs home with us last week when we were there.

Orders can be for carry out, or for consuming at simple picnic tables set under shade trees at the edge of a creek. Parking at peak lunch hours can be a little dicey, with lots of vehicles jockeying for limited spaces. Because it’s that good.
A perfect pit beef sandwich at a fantastically dicey place. Three booths only, not even attached to the wall. Barbecue sauce is amazing, you need plenty of napkins. Will be going back .

Amazing. When we go to get put beef anywhere else and say we want rare its like they dont hear us, at Jakes they definitely do. The prices are wonderful too. Very very very happy pregnant lady here lol

First time here and seating is horrible. The pit beef roll was saturated with blood and the meat looked raw and fatty. I lost my appetite and could not even eat it. This place needs a renovation. The booths seats are torn and need replaced. The whole experience was like eating in an old shed and trying to eat some horrible food. I recommend going somewhere else. This is not  the place to go for good food!
A winner every time! Go for the ribs, stay for the ribs lol but also check out the whole menu, it's so good.
customer_insights: Jake's Grill is a beloved casual spot in Baltimore known for its delicious pit beef and barbecue offerings. While the atmosphere is simple and rustic, the food quality has garnered a loyal following, making it a great choice for a laid-back meal with friends.

address: 11007 York Rd, Cockeysville, MD 21030, USA
googleReviews: Staying near by and found this place. Certainly looks like they've expanded adding outdoor and covered but open indoor seating. I went a little after 5pm on a random Tuesday and it was pretty empty. Service was friendly and fast. I got the brisket sandwich 8oz, corn bread, and Mac and cheese. I would recommend going with the 6oz, the 8 is enormous. It was lean but tasty. However, the cornbread was the star of the show, would highly recommend. The Mac and cheese was just ok. Solid spot for a meal.
Best Barbecue within an hour of my home other than Pioneer Pit Beef in Windsor Mill. Andy Nelson's has much more to offer though, including live music events and amazing southern sides.

Got the Memphis Double Combo with beef brisket and a pulled pork sandwich to go but they forgot the brisket… the sides were great, the cornbread, BBQ beans, and mac were on point. The pulled pork had some tanginess in it but it complimented their house bbq sauce which I think is vinegar based. Ribs are St Louis style cut and pretty tender, I think I’d go for dry next time as the sauce wasn’t really for me. I wasn’t getting a lot of smokiness from either which a bit disappointing but it was still pretty good.

This place is great! Their ribs (especially the dry style, which I liked best) were excellent and the atmosphere feels very southern cooking. They don't even have a fryer basket in the joint, which is awesome by me! More authentic that way. The ribs were fall off the bone, delicious, and we'll done. The staff were very friendly, prices are reasonable, and food tasty. What more could you ask for? 10/10 would recommend!

I’ve been here once a very long time ago and I was so excited to try it again because I remembered it being so good. I got the wet ribs, brisket, collards, Mac and cheese, corn bread, coleslaw, and sweet tea. The flavor of the ribs were great but I didn’t like that the meat itself was on the dryer side. I was slightly confused about the brisket. It was cut super thin, and very very dry even though the container the brisket came in seemed full of water. The brisket also didn’t really have any flavor. I really enjoyed the collard greens,  coleslaw, the sweet tea, and the corn bread though. The Mac and cheese was just not the type of Mac and cheese I like. Overall it was ok just wish the proteins had a little more love.
customer_insights: Andy Nelson's Barbecue offers a casual dining experience with a focus on smoked meats and southern sides. While the atmosphere is friendly and suitable for groups, the food quality can be inconsistent, particularly with the proteins. The venue also hosts live music events, adding to its appeal for a lively night out.

venueName: THE HH BBQ GRILL -The Heavenly Heavenly BBQ Grill
address: 2101-2111 E Monument St, Baltimore, MD 21205, USA
googleReviews: I swear by Heavenly.  I've been a customer roughly 10 years at 3 different locations-2 were the food truck.  Love the baked beans and collards!

If you ever see this food truck anywhere, go! No matter how long the line is! If the is long, that should tell you something.These folks are dedicated to their craft. They set up before 1 PM to prep and cook in the blazing hot sun to be ready for a 4 o'clock opening. Although it's called Heavenly Hot Dog, they are well known for their pit beef and turkey. Their ribs are heavenly! Oh, and they have hot dogs! Actually, anything on the menu is great! They are so nice and gracious and appreciate your business. The truck is clean and well equipped. They actually take the cooker to the site. Prices are reasonable, portions are generous! It's a black trailer with a big HH on the side, look for it! GO! Don't miss a chance for some of the best food from a food truck you may ever have! (Pics are pit beef and pit turkey with mayo and raw onions.) 😉

Ordered from HH BBQ Grill when they had a food truck at a local food truck event. I ordered the 1/4 Rack Ribs, Pit Chicken, Grilled BBQ Beans, and Mac & Cheese.

There was no real wait, which I assumed was because everything was already made and just had to be assembled and plated, so I thought "there's no way this order can be wrong " so, I assumed my order was correct since all the containers were accounted for in my bag; however, once I was home, I discovered my order was in fact, wrong. They doubled my Pit Chicken, so there was no 1/4 Rack Ribs, even though I was charged for it, which was disappointing since I was looking forward to the ribs. I was also disappointed to find out the chicken was dry with the only thing that slightly made up for it was the BBQ sauce they slathered on it; and the mac and cheese was very bland, which I was hoping to have had more seasoning/flavor. The best dish was only the Grilled BBQ Beans... Maybe visiting the store front in-person would have been a better experience, but I don't think I want to waste my money again.

Hands down the BEST food truck ever ! From the food to the customer service !!! Jasmine the cashier always smiling. Shaun the owner gave out tester ribs and they are perfect! So tender ! They are just So warm and friendly everytime I go. Recommend 1000% !!

Food is soooo good ! It made me felt like back home in Alabama yk we love some good bbq ! I will most definitely be back this won’t be the last time you’ll see us !! Them bbq ribs was soo good and the Mac n cheese just right I definitely didn’t have enough ! I need two orders of ribs ! I caught the end before sold out and it still was perfect ! We also had a polish dog 100/10 yall give  it a try you won’t be disappointed
customer_insights: The HH BBQ Grill is highly praised for its delicious BBQ offerings, particularly the ribs and pit beef. Customers appreciate the friendly service and the dedication of the staff, although some have reported inconsistencies in their orders. Overall, it is a beloved food truck with a loyal following.

venueName: Big Bad Wolf's House of Barbeque
address: 5713 Harford Rd, Baltimore, MD 21214, USA
googleReviews: Passed by this place for years but never tried it. The beef short ribs were very tender and flavorful. Out of the 3 I had 1 was a little charred. The beans had a very strong tomato base which I wasn't a fan of. These are not your typical sweet baked bean but if you like more of a tomato base they might be for you. The lady at the front taking orders was nice. Overall, nice no frills bbq spot.
So glad we found this BBQ for our lunch date. Delicious food, cozy location. The weather was perfect for dining outdoors.

Okay, so boom… me & my partner moved to this area last year and have been wanting to try Big Bad Wolf BBQ.

Because #1 I’m from Alabama and lived in TN for 8 years so I love a good BBQ & #2 the little yellow building is so stinking cute!!!

Upon arrival, the inside of the place was as expected. Quaint little space. A normal sized counter where you can order your food. We decided to order a full rack of pork ribs with the Kansas City Sweet sauce & a side of the Kansas City spicy sauce. We also got the family style mac&cheese, potato salad, & candied yams (as seen in the pics). As well as the “Big Bad Wolf” sandwich. The wait was only 15 minutes.

Full rack of Pork Ribs - FALL. OFF. THE. BONE. You do NOT need teeth to eat these. The Kansas City sweet sauce didn’t have as much depth as the spicy sauce so I’d say I preferred the spicy sauce. But these were REALLY good. I’d def go back for the ribs.

“Big Bad Wolf” - my partner got this and said it had the makings of a REALLY good sandwich. The meat, sauce, etc. was really good. But the bread tasted old, like it had been sitting around. But they still ate the whole thing so that tells you how good the meat was. They did say the XXX sauce wasn’t spicy at all.

The sides - the mac&cheese was cooked really well, you could tell it was baked, but it lacked seasoning and could’ve been a bit more cheesy. The candied yams were good. The potato salad had so much color (as seen in the pic) it looked like it was gonna be punchy as far as flavor goes however, it was bland. The cornbread was dry and tasted like it had been sitting out for a couple of days & it was too sweet for my taste.

All in all, I think folks should definitely stop by and try the ribs and/or the big bad wolf sandwich!!!

MKT price March 24th 2024 was $31.99 for pork & $38.99 for beef ribs. The sandwich was $11.99 and the sides were $6.99ea for family size which was big, in my opinion.

Atmosphere: You can't say much about the atmosphere because it's a small place. Basically, in and out place.
Service: Service was descent. The lady in front was polite and helped us with the menu. She manages well between in-house crowd and online orders that come via phone.
Food: Food is the most important part of a place that is selling food. We bought 2 pulled pork sandwiches and half bbq chicken. I was excited as I saw they had few pictures of newspaper cutout and magazines about them winning. The pulled pork sandwich was soaked in sauce to a point where the bottom half of bun was mushed to point where you couldn't even lift sandwiches out of containers. While pulled pork itself had no taste aside from a ton of sauce they had poured on it.
Now, the bbq chicken, the true meaning of bbq, is roasting or smoking the meat over wood or charcoal for long hours. Not on gas grill inside. As usual, chicken was soaked in sauce, and meat was tough and bland.
I should have understood to leave the place because, as a bbq enthusiast, I asked lady what style of bbq you do here, and she told me Kansas City sauce.
This place is insult to Kansas city style bbq.
In short, save your money. This place is good if you have never eaten any authentic style bbq. But if you have eaten Texas, NC style, or even Kansas city style. You will hate yourself because your dinner or lunch will be ruined with this food.
We had Big Bad Wolf cater a retirement party for 55 people. They were prompt, set up quickly, and made sure everything was in place. The food was fresh and delicious. highly recommend.
customer_insights: Big Bad Wolf's House of Barbeque is a cozy, no-frills spot known for its tender smoked meats, particularly the pork ribs. While the ambiance is casual and the service is friendly, the food quality can be inconsistent, with some dishes praised while others have received criticism for being bland or overly sauced.

address: 2102 Merritt Ave, Dundalk, MD 21222, USA
googleReviews:
WOW! A perfect foodie destination in a random, unassuming spot.

We drove an hour to do Bennets Curse Krampus Christmas and chose this spot blindly... fries are a 10/10 w/perfrct crisp and seasoning, 5 stack burger, crispy perfect wings, buffao chicken, mac cheese bacon chili dog all 10's. The *BEST* pitbeef of my life... perfectly cooked and seasoned with an amazing char taste. Every bite of food was great. I dont eat fast food (not real food), cook most of my own food, and am picky so it can be hard to find good food out lol.

Nita was the star of the night. Friendly, funny, personable, and accomodating for a front desk lady. Alllll the customers treated her like a long lost sister and she treated them like family.

As we were leaving and giving compliments, the owner and family walked out, said thanks and were so incredibly gracious.

Smokin' Joe's food is A- Mazing!!! Every item I've tried is just to die for and I have had a lot of the menu items. Rose absolutely fantastic. She has great customer service skills, she's always smiling and super helpful. Tee is also awesome. He's nice, he's helpful and very personable. They are both friendly and I swear it seems like they know what I'll need before I do!! Thank you Rose and Tee for always making every visit to Smokin' Joe's a great experience!!!

Run don't walk and get some of this delicious food! This was my first time here and I was pleasantly surprised. So friendly, so delicious and a cozy atmosphere. We had the brisket sliders and steak sub. Delicious! The fries were so crispy and good.

First time trying the physical location, my old company had catered food from here for Christmas last year. Nice spread, dry rub and bbq wings, trio meat platter with fixings and buns, ribs. Not much was left over after the party.

I think the buns could be a little larger for the application, my bun fell apart as soon as I picked it up. Love that they use red onion on the sandwich, usually see yellow for pit beef. I got the duo meat pit and ham, did not think my pit was medium but ate fine. Nice pile of protein, did not leave hungry.

Love the fries, done boardwalk style and fried just right. Cheese sauce was good too, cook came out and said he just made some.

I thought they put a good amount of cheese on the hamburgers, took a bite off my wife's when she was done, definitely rich. Did not think the burger had any internal flavor though, like they rely on sauces or other condiments.

Decent BBQ spot, wouldn't call it the best. Would love to see some house made bbq sauces.

Will be back to try some ribs!

Been going to Smokin Joe’s Grill for years now & always have an excellent experience. Food is always delicious & fresh. The customer service is outstanding & they are always offering free samples of new items they are offering. I highly recommend giving them a try if you haven’t already been there.
customer_insights: Smokin' Joe's Grill is a beloved casual dining spot in Baltimore known for its delicious barbecue and friendly service. Customers rave about the quality of the food, particularly the pit beef and crispy fries, and appreciate the welcoming atmosphere created by the staff.

address: 4122 Washington Blvd, Halethorpe, MD 21227, USA
googleReviews: I couldn’t like this place any more if I tried. Nice folks serving some of the tastiest pit beef, brisket, mac/cheese and fries you could ever wish for. And I’m not going to lie, the whole pit beef/liquor store combo was unusually cool. Johnny “guarding” the restroom door was pretty damn cute too. Not sure when we will fly into Baltimore next but this place will be on the list to visit.

I absolutely love this place. The young lady behind the counter takes so much pride in her job and the best customer service.  The food is some of the best around. Perfectly smoked. The wings and fries are crispy and so delicious. The BBQ and Pit Beef are also perfectly cooked.

Definitely a hidden gem inside a liquor store.

The food was amazing,  I got the half rack of ribs they were tender and smokey. The ribs came with two Sides and two wings. You could get smoked wings, old bay, or bbq. I got the old bay wings and baked beans and mac and cheese for my sides. The service was friendly and the food took about 15 - 20 to come out so definitely order ahead if you do carry out. It all came up to $21. Overall I had a very gpod experience and will definitely be going back.

This was one of the best….if not THE best brisket sandwich I’ve ever had. Excellent! (So good that I haven’t even left the restaurant yet and I’m already posting this review!) The meat was tender, the BBQ sauce was perfectly tangy, the Kaiser roll was soooo soft and fresh!! The fresh cut fries were delicious! The service was great too….. they were super nice and helpful. It’s got a cool vibe too! 😎

We absolutely loved the food here. My picky child devoured his bbq chicken sandwich, the ribs fell right off the bone and were incredible! The cornbread was sweet and amazing! It's a small place but the place was VERY clean and the service was incredible! We will definitely be back the next time we drive through Baltimore

And oh the chicken tenders ❤️... Everyone loved the food!
customer_insights: Bonfire Outdoor Charcoal Grill is a casual dining spot known for its delicious BBQ and pit beef, with a friendly atmosphere and great customer service. It's a hidden gem located inside a liquor store, making it a unique stop for both locals and visitors. The venue is particularly suitable for a laid-back meal with friends but may not be ideal for romantic occasions.

address: N Rolling Rd &, Johnnycake Rd, Catonsville, MD 21228, USA
googleReviews: This is the most flavorful and juicy Pit Beef in town. In my opinion, it is the best! Quality is consistent every time, and I love that it is still a classic Pit Beef stand rather than a whole restaurant. It's quick and easy that way. They shouldn't change a thing...it is perfect! Just remember that it is cash only.

Great example of Baltimore pit beef. Small menu, pit ham and turkey available  as well. Only open lunch hours, 1100-1700. I've driven by here a few times, easily seen from the intersection and today it was on my route between jobs.

Decent line when I showed up and an even longer line while I waited. I stood in line 20-25 minutes but once I ordered I revived my food in quickly. People ahead of me were ordering multiple sandwiches.

Loved the pit beef, would try any pit meat here. Cash only. Good rolls, decent condiment section. The regular size sandwhich is a filling portion of protein, the super looks like a good one to pick loose pieces off of.

Small no frills shack. There's a reason the line is long.

I ordered the Pitt beef sub. It was fresh. You can customize by adding cheese, toppings and sauces of your choice. Fries are hand cut and delicious. Usually there’s a long line but I went this time around 4pm and there was no wait

Pioneer pit beef is a Baltimore tradition.  It is cash  only and they only have picnic benches for seating.  So what? They focus solely on pit beef and making it right. No frills.  I took my wife this weekend and the food was amazing as always.  I always get the "super" with "tiger sauce" and it is a monster sandwich.  The beef is moist and tender never stringy or fatty. The quality is excellent. The folks behind the counter I've known for over ten years. They are awesome.  Yes, it is behind a liquor store and almost under the overpass.  Come here for the pit beef.

Ideal for a quick bite before or after other nightlife activities.

googleReviews: I wish I could give ten stars, this place is amazing. The wings and homemade vegan ranch were out of this world; the Philly cheese fake and pumpkin muffin were also incredible. This was my first time visiting this restaurant, and it definitely won’t be my last! The food was amazing, and the drinks and smoothie were delicious 😋. We ordered the buffalo wings, guacamole with chips, a sandwich (can’t remember the name), the peanut butter berries smoothie, and the Phat Beet juice. Let me tell you we were not disappointed!

Each item had its own flavor, and you could taste the freshness in every bite. The prices were affordable and reasonable, the staff was friendly and professional, and the chef was clearly on point with his cooking. I don’t live in the area, but every time I’m in town, I’ll be making sure to stop here for a good Liquid Earth meal!

10/10 STRONGLY RECOMMEND.

I was in Baltimore and wanted to support a vegan establishment, so I decided to try Liquid Earth based on the great reviews and proximity to my hotel. Although it's on a busier street, the surrounding neighborhood has tree lined streets (some cobbled) with historic rowhouses. I enjoyed my walk exploring the area.

It was a hot day, and I arrived hungry! I started with a cup of the gazpacho. It arrived with a wheel of lime to squeeze on top and some crisp baguette toasts.  The gazpacho was so flavorful,  cooling, and refreshing. I could feel my vitality being restored as I finished it off.

For the main course, I ordered the Sacred Salad and asked to add a scoop of the tofu salad. This was a power move! The salad was a feast for the eyes as well as the palate- a work of art! The tofu salad featured pleasingly firm chunks of tofu in a creamy base and it was perfect for scooping up with all the fresh veggies and greens. I finished things off with one of the 2oz juice shots, 'the uninflamed,' made with ginger, pineapple, and turmeric. Delicious!

If you're in the Baltimore area, and even if you're not vegan, check out Liquid Earth. The atmosphere is welcoming and homey, service is great, the playlist is on point, and the food here is something special!

The food here is top tier — fresh, flavorful, and thoughtfully prepared every time. It’s hands down one of my favorite spots to enjoy delicious vegan and vegetarian meals. Highly recommend if you’re looking for plant-based dishes that actually hit the spot! ❤️

Noble and the team were very welcoming upon arrival. I was in town for a work trip so wanted to see what Liquid Earth has to offer.  Upon entering, the restaurant is a fun and cozy spot with some cool antique figurines on display. I ordered a 2oz shot of Good Guts and the Reuben sandwich with the roasted red onions. Delicious from first bite to the last. Highly recommend.
customer_insights: Liquid Earth is a highly recommended vegan restaurant in Baltimore, known for its fresh, flavorful dishes and friendly service. The cozy atmosphere and artistic presentation of food make it a great spot for casual dining, whether for a first date or a night out with friends.

googleReviews:
We recently took a trip from Philadelphia down to Baltimore, Maryland to visit a little place we've been wanting to check out - Dodah's Kitchen. Known for their fantastic vegan cakes in Philadelphia, it was a no-brainer to stop by. They are 100% vegan and we've heard so many good things about their food, we had to try it for ourselves.

Arriving on a Friday around 5 PM, the place wasn't too busy as people were likely on their way home from work. The ambiance had a nice vibe, despite the cold air conditioning blasting at 60°. It took a little bit of searching to find someone at the counter, and there was a small language barrier as the person mostly spoke Spanish. However, pointing at certain items helped clear the confusion. After requesting to turn off the air conditioning, things started to feel more comfortable.

The layout of the restaurant was unique, with plants covering each table for added privacy. With nice background music playing, we finally decided on our order - vegan barbecued ribs, breaded vegan fried chicken wings, seafood mac & cheese, regular mac & cheese, breaded vegan fried shrimp, and a shrimp wrap. It was a lot of food, but we wanted to try a bit of everything.

The food arrived in about 15 minutes, and we asked for takeout containers in anticipation of the large portions. The breaded vegan fried chicken wings were a pleasant surprise, tasting so close to real chicken. The vegan ribs were delicious with just the right amount of barbecue sauce. The seafood mac & cheese had a nice flavor, though we weren't sure about the seafood chunks.

Overall, our experience was good. Though I'm not a big fan of comfort food, Dodah's Kitchen has won me over with their vegan options. I particularly enjoyed the vegan chicken wings and ribs. And their cakes are a must-try if you have the chance. They truly stand out in the vegan dessert department.

Ordered to go and loved the portions. I've had their Mac n cheese from MOM's Organics so I was excited to see they had a location in DC and wanted to try more food. The general tso cauliflower is very good! I love their vegan cheesecake as well!

As a vegetarian I obviously I'm excited that a restaurant such as this exists. But I have to be honest I was a bit disappointed by the food. The portion sizes are large which I appreciated. But the taste was very starchy and carb heavy.  The homemade sauce of that orange chicken or whatever it is was not great either. A lot of the side dishes were not fresh and clearly have been sitting there for a while. To be fair we went right before they closed.  They had to make a new batch of ribs which took about half hour. The guy working there was very nice.  I really hate knocking this place, because I wish there were more vegan restaurants. But I don't think I'll return. Prices there are quite high, too.

Paid $37 for a truly disappointing meal. I originally ordered the drummies but was told they were sold out only after placing the order. I was then offered tenders and crab cakes as substitutes. For sides, I chose mac and cheese and quinoa.

After a 25-minute wait, I opened the box to find food that looked unappetizing — and unfortunately, it tasted even worse. The tenders were mediocre, the crab cakes were bland, and the mac and cheese was barely edible. I ended up throwing away 80% of the meal.

The only redeeming part of the experience was the Colada Moss drink — that was excellent. Everything else was a waste of money. I miss Grub Factory — the food was better, and the chef actually knew what they were doing.

So this was my very first visit. I was informed of a vegan restaurant near my job. Anyway, I got the ribs, fried fish, collard greens, and ginger mint lemonade. It was pretty tasty for what it was. The lemonade was delicious. The greens were great. The ribs were not the best but were decent. I meant to do this review last Fri when I went. They should play edited music. I had my daughter with me. SMH 🤦🏾. I wish the food could be covered because I saw fruit flies in seating area. There was no wait and two staff members working. I would recommend and go back again. The restaurant was very nice though but a lot of the items like cake and Mac and cheese were sold out.
customer_insights: Dodah's Kitchen offers a unique vegan dining experience with a variety of comfort food options. While many patrons appreciate the generous portion sizes and some standout dishes like the vegan chicken wings and cakes, there are mixed reviews regarding the overall taste and freshness of certain items. The casual atmosphere makes it suitable for a relaxed outing, but it may not be ideal for special occasions.

I soon determined the chalkboard menu food stand items were the only things offered. I would have liked to purchase more items like desserts or sides etc. and willingly dropped $100+ as I've done in other BOB vegan spots.

Suggestion: Please remove the ordering online menu links to Toast Local, DoorDash, UberEats, etc. if none of those menu items are current. It's confusing.

I've never had food there before so I needed input. I had to pull teeth to get some recommendations from at least one of the 2 cooks on what was popular or what they personally liked. Neither of them were friendly and looked uncomfortable responding to my questions. It was extremely awkward.

Suggestion: Provide a physical menu with photos of some of the food. Post signs and advertise about popular items.

There is no kitchen, and the two same male employees were taking turns cooking the food on a medium sized griddle. That visual presentation in itself was unsettling to me. It visually looked low budget. No hood and no ventilation needed for the smoke from the greasy buttery foods they fry either? There was also a commercial refrigerator but hardly anything in it for me to be greedy and buy. Why?

In the food industry, food presentation is important. All of my sandwiches were gooey and soggy. I could not eat the sub or the burger due to this. However, the Triple BLT was tasteful and I managed to eat that.

Suggestion: The cooks need to wrap the burgers and other fried foods loosely so they have room to "breathe".  You may think that a tight wrap will keep the food fresh, but all it does is seal in moisture and ensure that it will be soggy if it isn’t eaten fast. Also, placing them in plastic bags just keeps all the moisture inside and compounds the problem of a soggy mess and unappetizing food.

Overall, this experience wasn't what I expected and I was disappointed 😕.

This final statement is for the owner Ms. Wyatt: I've read many of your reviews and your responses particularly to the negative ones. I understand your heart is in this and you love your people and your community.  Yet, some people are observing how you respond to bad feedback. Becoming brashly defensive and even rude when responding to customers is the symptom, not the problem. The customers are presenting you with the problem or "their problem".

What will your solution continue to be? There's an expression: "Never assume that every critic is a hater. Not everyone is hating on you. Some people are telling you the truth."  We can love our business and our community all day long. But, the end goal is to make money and feed our families. Each customer you lose is a revenue loss and can cause you to lose another customer (more revenue) due to bad reviews and/or how you respond to those reviews. It's really something to think about and adjust (if you choose).

Overall, I wish you nothing but the best.

address: 3360 Chestnut Ave, Baltimore, MD 21211, USA
googleReviews:
Great Bites, Minor Flights of Frustration 🚀🌱

This local launchpad dishes out some seriously tasty bites—but be prepared for a few quirks in your mission log.

🍔 Beyond Burger w/ Facon & Bleu Cheese
Originally came for their Black & Bleu Burger, only to discover the menu online is a relic from a bygone galaxy. Pivoted to a Beyond Burger with facon and a side of bleu cheese. Honestly? Still a win. Smoky, savory, and satisfying—though a little blackened seasoning would’ve taken it to hyperspace.

🥬 Brussels Sprouts
These deserve their own orbit. Crispy, charred, flavorful—possibly the best part of the meal. No Jedi mind tricks here—just phenomenal execution.

🥒 Fried Pickles
Tasty and crunchy, but $9 for five spears? That’s almost $2 per pickle spear (basically one pickle sliced five ways). For that price, I expected them to sing... or at least harmonize with the ranch.

🧊 Iced Tea
Refills? You’ll need to sell a droid. $4 with no refills was enough to send me straight to a glass of water. And honestly—on a meal over $40 (with food, tax, and tip), a refill should be part of the package. It's tea, not hyperfuel.

📱 ToastTab Digital Menu
Here’s the curveball: you scan a QR code and are expected to order through your phone using Toast. Fine in theory—until you realize they ask for everything: name, phone, email, card info, mailing address... just to order dinner. Felt more like applying for a mortgage than grabbing a burger. I ended up going up to the bar to order directly (pro tip: there are no servers to take your order at the table).

🚀 Final Verdict
Rocket to Venus lands a solid hit with flavor—especially those Brussels sprouts—but the outdated website menu and ToastTab data grab threw off the flight path. Still worth a visit, just bring your patience, your appetite, and maybe… your own refillable iced tea.
I ordered a Hex Kambucha Moscow Mule and their Gumbo. Best Gumbo since visiting Louisiana. It was spicy enough, I had to order a second Mule

This is a great spot for an intimate date night or game night w friends. Theres gently of free street parking. Will definitely be back!

We’ve eaten here twice—once for brunch and tonight for dinner (10/24/25). Both times the food has been delicious. We celebrated our son’s 13 birthday here with family and friends. The setting was perfect and with easy street parking - the space itself was welcoming, clean, and great for a private party. Between the fabulous family style table and tv, we controlled our music and vibe and were able to play games in a way your average restaurant just can’t accommodate. We so appreciate their generous hospitality and look forward to coming back soon! Highly recommend!

I heard that the smash burgers were great.  That is an understatement.  They simply exploded with flavor.  I don't know if it was a special blend of spices or the way the meat was cooked but ... damn it was good.  My wife devoured the sweet potato fries before I could get any but she tells me they were very good.  I also ordered the buffalo wings which had something special about them.  Parmesan or a special sauce, perhaps?  My wife, who won't eat wings, ate two of them.  That's all I would let her have.

A special treat was meeting the owner.  He (and all the staff) was especially friendly and attentive to our needs. Obviously, I was absolutely delighted with our evening.  I highly recommend the Brick Bistro.  We arrived late evening so it was quiet which is the way I like it but there were plenty of customers eating in secluded glassed-in rooms.  An interesting concept.

Atmosphere was great. Food was good. Just would like more clarification on the room rates. Been multiple times but it seems like the rates aren't fixed.. hearing it's $100 .. one time they didn't charge at all.. another time they tried charging $50 for the room.. another time charging over $150 for the room.. really would like to get a set price instead of feeling like they adjust them based on traffic
customer_insights: Brick Bistro Hampden is a charming venue known for its friendly service and delicious food, making it ideal for intimate gatherings and celebrations. The unique atmosphere, with options for private dining, enhances the overall experience, though some guests have noted inconsistencies with room pricing.

First time at Birroteca and we enjoyed our meal.

We made a reservation for outside, and didn't love the patio as it was a bit more rustic than we were expecting, and the mosquitos were out! Next time we'll plan to sit indoors. Plenty of parking if you're driving. Indoors looked warm and inviting, and was bustling.

We ordered some of their signature drinks, I got their Birroteca dirty martini and it had a deliciously spiced rim- skip if you can't handle spice.

We also tried the mushroom pasta with homemade fettuccine- delicious, and the Duck Duck Goose pizza. Also delicious. My husband ate an entire order of garlic bread so I guess he must have enjoyed that!

This is a great date night or outing with friends spot.

Great spot for a meal in a lovely location with ample parking! Every dish we tried was delicious, except for the pasta with pesto, which was unfortunately a bit bitter and served cold. Despite that, I would definitely recommend this place for both lunch and dinner. Looking forward to coming back!

Cute place, kinda out of the way. They have a happy hour menu. Tried the Brussels sprouts, but didn't get them the way they're regularly prepared because there is pork in the topping. They were still OK. Appreciate the attentiveness of our server letting us know that there was pork in the preparation of them after hearing that someone didn't eat pork.
Pizza was pretty good, DEFINITELY share size.
Can't remember the name of the drinks, but they had Deep Eddy,  juice, and another ingredient. We tried lemon, cranberry, and grapefruit and liked them all.
Lots of music and the bar area was HYPE, ESPECIALLY for it not to be a Friday night. Would definitely go back.

Still going strong! When many places I have loved in Baltimore have closed, I am glad Birroteca is still here.  Had a wonderful dinner Sunday with my parents.  We love their bolognese, caesar salad with delicious bread crumbs, pizza. I think the garlic bread is new? It was so good! My server could have been a little more attentive he seemed busy and didn’t tell us the specials.

Very nice restaurant. A bit out of the way, but GPS takes you right there. We had a reservation, and we were seated immediately.

The place is clean and neat. I'm a fan of tablecloths, and Birroteca uses them. The food was fresh and delicious, and the portions were generous. Side dishes come in their own plates and are sized for sharing.

We arrived during happy hour which means that some drinks and some appetizers are reduced in price. My wife and her cousin shared a pizza, and there was still enough pizza left over to take home. I had the P. E. I. mussels in red sauce as my main course. It's an appetizer, but there's plenty of food in the bowl.

There's free parking in their lot. The restaurant is wheelchair accessible. I recommend this place. And I recommend that you get a reservation. The Biroteca gets plenty of customers.
customer_insights: Birroteca Baltimore offers a delightful dining experience with a focus on Italian cuisine, particularly pasta and pizza. The ambiance is upscale yet inviting, making it suitable for various occasions, from casual outings to romantic dinners. Customers appreciate the attentive service and the vibrant atmosphere, especially during happy hour.

address: 601 S Clinton St, Baltimore, MD 21224, USA
googleReviews: I was very excited to try this place. I was mostly excited about the drink menu. It was a bar so not to very exciting. The atmosphere was chill. It had some cool decor.

The themed cocktails were especially good. They were really busy and seemed to be understaffed, but our server kept up pretty well. We had a great time and will definitely go back again.

I can’t say enough wonderful things about the Annabelle Lee Tavern! While visiting Baltimore, this is a must see. Beautifully decorated with macabre decor and paintings  of Poe and other elements of his famous works such as the raven, and Annabelle Lee herself. Beyond the spooky visual interest, the tavern has a cozy vibe and feel to it. If I was a local, I would absolutely become a bar regular. My “MORBID RUMINATION” cocktail (made with gin, maraschino cherry liquor, gin etc) as well as my espresso martini were out of this world. Jessica was our bartender and server, and she was so knowledgeable about the restaurant, cocktail menu, and absolutely wonderful to chat with. For dinner, I ordered the crab cake sandwich, which came in a bun with lettuce and tomato and a side of sweet potato fries. When in Baltimore it is imperative to get quality crab, and this sandwich truly delivered as it was full of large pieces of lump crab meat with a wonderful flavor. 10/10 evening full of fond memories and delicious food and drink, I can’t wait to return on my next trip!

We had a nice little stop at the Annabel Lee Tavern.   It was mid day and the hot summer sun was taking its toll.  We stepped into a little shrine to an epic American writer and heart broken man whose legacy seems attached to his poetic despair

Ready to indulge in the experience we were met with their prejudice towards a prefered liquor,  so we had copious amounts of water.   Which was probably a better choice as we awaited our cheese steak and chicken sandwich

The sweet potatoe fries were among the best we've had.   The cheese steak had a nice mix of peppers and looked great with obvious cheese action on the top!  but failed to wow with flavor and turned into left overs

I'd probably eat there again... if there wasn't other choices.  Still worth a visit if you're on the fence
Great Poe themed pub!  I make a point of going everytime i'm in Baltimore.  Food is great, and I've been made to feel like a regular each time I've walked in the door.
customer_insights: Annabel Lee Tavern offers a unique Edgar Allan Poe-themed experience with a cozy atmosphere. Guests appreciate the friendly service and themed cocktails, though food quality can vary. It's a great spot for casual gatherings and late-night visits.

address: 1028 S Conkling St, Baltimore, MD 21224, USA

I first visited here over a month ago for a private event and overall the service was great and the food and drinks were delicious. I think from the time we ordered it took about 45 minutes before our food came out which isn’t a probably per se. The restaurant is also located on the corner of the street so it is street parking with some pay to park spots along the side right across the street. It is free on Sundays.

Where the restaurant earned their stars for me was their service. Despite being short staffed, everyone was in great spirits and no one expressed any sort of frustration or annoyance with the customers. They also chatted with the customers and laughed which was such a nice touch to the visit!

We've loved this place ever since the first time we opened the door. The bar is MAGNIFICENT! A classic beauty in a warm and inviting atmosphere. Lots of nice sitting spaces and charming appointments. Low music and style fit the couples and friends that gather. The staff is supremely engaging, warm and inviting of you to their place. Great cocktails and excellent craft beers on tap. address: 8201 Snowden River Pkwy Ste D, Columbia, MD 21045, USA
googleReviews:
What’s not to like about this place???
It has fun and comfortable atmosphere , attentive service, delicious food with seasonal variations, large drinks selections, in addition - price is not bad at all.

Love to come here for a relaxing date night or gathering with friends. We always have a good time.

My wife and I have been here many times which is why I gave Victoria's four stars. Most of their food is delicious. The duck fat fries are incredible.

This time I had the Pub Skirt Steak. I asked for medium rare. The flavor was pretty good. The steak lacked a nice sear and was undercooked in places. Some even close to blue. The potatoes were okay. A little too garlicky and could've used more salt. The broccolini was unremarkable as well. Maybe slightly under cooked.

My wife has the grilled salmon. She let me taste it. We both could not stop commenting on how delicious the dish was. I really thought the crispy shitake was ingenious.

They also have a great beer selection. We will be back again. I just wouldn't recommend the pub skirt steak.

We went Victorias for a AWWA networking event held in the outdoor section. The food spread selection was absolutely amazing with something for everyone. The food presentation was stunning. I would never had expected such attention to detail form the chef. It was a 10 out of 10.   My favorite app was the cheese stuffed meatballs. They had a slightly crunchy exterior and a warm and gooey interior. The meatballs were not greasy at all and were just the right size for a 2 bite app. I would like to try them on a meatball sub! Even though we only had one waitress, the service was amazing. The waitress was fast and delivered my drink no matter where I was standing in the event. I never waited for a drink even though there we had 40 + people.  Victorias Gastro Pub got everything right.

First Impression

Victoria’s is one of those spots that balances cozy neighborhood vibes with elevated pub fare — the kind of place where you can come casual but leave talking about the food like it’s fine dining.

What I Ordered

I went with the waffles stacked with sausage and bacon, and let me tell you — this dish is pure weekend comfort. The waffle was golden and crisp on the outside, fluffy inside, and it held its own against the savory richness of the meats. The sausage brought the spice, the bacon added that perfect salty crunch, and together it was the ultimate sweet-meets-savory bite (especially with a drizzle of maple syrup). And yes, I had this with a nice cold glass of beer for brunch.

Service & Atmosphere

Service was attentive but relaxed — exactly the kind of energy you want at brunch. The space has that warm gastropub feel: lively but not overwhelming, with a great mix of families, couples, and groups of friends.

Standout Details

The menu has plenty of creative spins, but what stood out to me was how balanced the dish was. It didn’t feel heavy or greasy, just indulgent in the right way. Pair it with a mimosa or one of their local beers, and you’ve got yourself a brunch worth bragging about.

Wrap-Up

Victoria’s Gastropub nails the sweet spot between comfort food and elevated dining. If you’re in Columbia and craving waffles with a twist, this place delivers big time.

I came here to try their lobster grilled cheese sandwich. Slapfish in Rockville closed down so I thought I’d give this place a try. I tried the lobster grilled cheese and duck fat fries. Personally, I wasn’t impressed. The sandwich was a 5/10. It wasn’t nasty but it wasn’t great. The duck fat fries had an interesting taste and they were mostly broken up fries. I doubt I will be back.
customer_insights: Victoria Gastro Pub offers a cozy atmosphere with a diverse menu that includes elevated pub fare. Guests appreciate the attentive service and the creative twists on comfort food, making it suitable for various occasions from casual gatherings to date nights.

address: 206 W Pratt St, Baltimore, MD 21201, USA

customer_insights: Pratt Street Ale House is a casual dining venue known for its warm atmosphere and friendly service. Guests appreciate the variety of food options, including local craft beers and bar snacks, making it a great spot for pregame gatherings or casual outings with friends.

Good service, otherwise, everyone was very nice.

We had the Salmon and the Mediterranean Chicken. The salmon was cooked perfectly and the chicken was juicy and done just right.

We had the Apple Tart with vanilla ice cream for desert. The Apple Tart was fresh, warm and very tasteful.

address: 2706 Dillon St, Baltimore, MD 21224, USA
googleReviews:
I walked into Mahaffey’s Pub expecting a good beer and a decent bite.
I did not expect to have a life-altering, borderline spiritual moment delivered to me in the form of a cheesesteak so glorious it deserves its own mural in Canton.

The kitchen is right in the front of the bar, so you get to witness the artistry firsthand. Watching them build this sandwich is like watching a blacksmith forge a legendary weapon:
the sizzle of the steak hitting the flat top, the rhythmic chopping, the careful layering of cheese until it melts into a glossy, golden river… I was hypnotized before it even hit the plate.

And when it arrived?
Pure perfection.

The meat is tender, seasoned, and stacked with the confidence of a bar that knows it’s serving the best cheesesteak in Baltimore. The cheese isn’t sprinkled—it’s fused, bonded to the meat like it was born there. The roll is toasted just enough to hold the avalanche together, but soft enough to disappear into each bite. Add the fresh crunch of lettuce and tomato and you’ve got a cheesesteak so balanced it could win a Nobel Prize in Structural Engineering.

This thing isn’t a sandwich.
It’s an experience.
It’s the cheesesteak that other cheesesteaks look at and whisper, “One day…”

If you come to Mahaffey’s and don’t order the cheesesteak, you’re committing a culinary crime. This is the best cheesesteak I’ve ever had—Philly included—and I will die on this hill.

Mahaffey’s Pub: where legends are made, one sandwich at a time.
One of the great neighborhood bars in Canton. Great place to just hang with your crew. Also very nice kids area up top so you can still socialize while watching your littles.

Mahaffey’s Pub is an absolute gem!
From the moment you walk in, you feel like a regular—even if it’s your first time. The atmosphere strikes the perfect balance between cozy neighborhood bar and vibrant hangout spot. The beer selection is top-notch, with an impressive rotation of local craft brews and hard-to-find favorites.
The staff? Genuinely friendly, fast, and know their stuff. You can tell they love what they do. The food goes way beyond typical bar fare—everything is fresh, flavorful, and made with care. Whether you're popping in for a quick drink or settling in for a night out with friends, Mahaffey’s never disappoints.
Easily one of the best spots in town. Can’t wait to come back!
Jerk chicken sandwich with the rosemary garlic fries was so good. Great hospitality at this pub too.

This pub is fantastic! The staff are incredibly friendly, welcoming, and attentive, which makes the whole atmosphere warm and enjoyable. The service is truly top-notch — everything was fast, professional, and with a smile. A great place to relax, have a drink, and feel taken care of. Highly recommend!
customer_insights: Mahaffey's Pub is a beloved neighborhood bar in Canton, known for its friendly atmosphere and exceptional cheesesteaks. The venue is perfect for casual hangouts with friends and offers a family-friendly environment, making it a great spot for both guys and girls nights out.

address: 24 W Franklin St, Baltimore, MD 21201, USA
googleReviews:
I stayed at Hotel Indigo for a conference and decided to try Poets for dinner. I was honestly pleasantly surprised because hotel restaurants can be a gamble, but this one did not disappoint 😌✨. I ordered the Indigo Burger and it was delicious. Juicy, flavorful, and exactly what I needed after a long day.

The waitress was amazing. Super nice, very attentive, and patient with all our questions. She even gave us great recommendations, which is always a good sign. The service alone had me impressed.

I liked it so much that I came back a couple days later for breakfast. I ordered a simple plate with eggs, bacon, and potatoes, and let me tell you… those potatoes were everything 🥔😍. They had that perfect little crunch on the outside, soft on the inside, and seasoned like someone’s auntie was in the back pouring love into the skillet. They were so good I even recommended them to another potato lover.

Overall, Poets definitely exceeded my expectations. Great service, great food, and now I’m slightly obsessed with their potatoes 😂🔥.

⭐️ – A Breakfast That Left a Bad Taste… Literally and Figuratively 🍳☕🚫

Had breakfast at Poets Restaurant (inside the Indigo Hotel), and unfortunately, it was a very disappointing experience from the moment I walked in.

When I arrived, I was immediately told, “We’re short-staffed,”—no “Good morning,” no “Welcome,” just straight into the disclaimer. Not the warmest way to be greeted before coffee. Once I was seated, the waitress walked over and said, “If you just want coffee, sit at the bar.” I told her I wanted to eat as well, but she didn’t really listen—just pointed out that I already had water and walked away. Again, no greeting, no acknowledgment, no basic hospitality.

It took 10–15 minutes before she returned to take my order. I asked for the eggs benedict, which, when it arrived, was so over-salted it was almost inedible. I managed maybe a fourth of the plate before giving up. The coffee was forgettable too—flat, weak, nothing special.

But honestly, the worst part wasn’t even the food. It was the atmosphere, which felt unwelcoming, rushed, and inattentive. At no point did I feel like a guest, or even like a customer. It felt like I was in the way.

Bottom line: The setting may look nice, but the service was cold, the food was disappointing, and I walked out more annoyed than full. Definitely would not recommend, and I won’t be returning.

Jeff was our oh so professional and kind waiter. He had a great and pleasant personality. Super down to earth and excellent in service with our order. He knew the menu and what was available for us to enjoy. Jeff is top notch and so was the front desk staff that suggested we come back for live jazz on Thursday evenings. The food was tasty. The crab cake could have been a bit better but overall everything was delicious. The cheese cake was a special treat we enjoyed. Thanks Jeff, Indigo hotel staff and Poets Modern Cocktails & Eats. We had an enjoyable evening 😊
Crab Cake is very much sure menu 🦀🥟, really tasteful 100% packed crab-ball. Both pasta also a must. I forgot to take Crab-dip, but also a must starter. Hotel restaurant provides fantastic service.

Nice looking room. Cocktail service was nice but just a touch slow.

TLDR: Go someplace else.

Breakfast was another matter so together. After spending over $200 for an overnight room, we came down to breakfast to be abruptly told, "twenty minute wait". There was no hello or good morning.... There were plenty of open tables and what looked like three or four servers standing around, so I asked if we could have a table and was told, "I just told you there is a twenty minute wait." I asked why and was told they only have one cook. I asked if we could get some coffee while we waited and was told no. We left and went to the ceremony coffee shop two blocks away where we were treated great and had an amazing time.

Crappy attitude.
customer_insights: Poets Modern Cocktails & Eats offers a mix of positive and negative dining experiences, with standout dishes like the Indigo Burger and crab cakes, while service can be inconsistent. The venue is suitable for casual dining and social gatherings, especially with live jazz on Thursdays, making it a trendy spot for both locals and hotel guests.

address: 1700 E Fort Ave, Baltimore, MD 21230, USA
googleReviews: We went here before leaving for a cruise out of Baltimore. It is right around the corner from the cruise port. Food was good. Drinks were strong. I liked that they labeled the TV's with which game would be on each so you could pick a seat that would face a tv with your game on it. If your in the area especially on an NFL Sunday it is definitely worth a try.

The best salad I’ve had in a long time. 2nd time coming for their house salad w/ grilled shrimp, and they offered me a sample of their voodoo sauce… FLAVOR TOWN.
Always consistent. Always good. Great staff. Thank you, City Limits! DE-LISSH.

There are plenty of TVs, so you can watch several sporting events at once.
The food is good for bar food.
Often there are not enough servers, so service can be painfully slow.

Brunch was great. Visit in '22 & '23.
I had Mexican Eggs Benedict both times. It was delicious. Tots were so tasty (salty) and the cilantro-lime sauce added quite a zing without overpowering the eggs and ground chorizo sausage. The first one (pic) they brought me had the smallest eggs I've ever seen and they were cook hard, so I asked for a redo and the next dish had the biggest eggs I've ever seen (pic) just poached, so yolk was all runny.
They over-poached my eggs on 2nd visit too. And chorizo was overcooked and almost dry.
Vegetarian wife and I loved their Mashed Potato Quesadilla, I know sounds weird, but it was quite good. Might want to ask for some guacamole to give more depth. Pico was so tasty.
House recipe Bloody Mary was delicious. Had a bit of horseradish floating around in there.
Buffalo Cauliflower bites were great. Lightly breaded with good sauce.

Sports pub with some pet friendly outdoor seating. My husband loved his burger & fries. I really enjoyed the 3 shrimp tacos. Preferring their fried shell over the soft. The beans & rice were very flavorful but dry. Had our dog with us so we sat at a sidewalk table. Server was very friendly and helpful.
customer_insights: City Limits is a casual sports bar ideal for pregame gatherings and enjoying a lively atmosphere, especially on NFL Sundays. While the food is generally well-received, service can be slow during busy times, and the venue is pet-friendly with outdoor seating.

If you are looking to go have a few drinks, the place looks like it could be fun, and with the addition of alcohol,  the food might pass for acceptable.

Very friendly welcoming from bartender, Rochelle. We glanced at the menu before arriving. There is a TOGO that is separate from the Turp’s  bar/dining. Excellent food. I can see why this place has positive reviews. It feels like a neighborhood spot and a travelers’ spot. Wings were wonderful. The sweet potato tots were delicious. Signature Viccino, pretty solid. Thank you for the great food and hospitality, Turp’s! Until next trip.

Heard about this deep fried sandwich (Monte Cristo) and just had to try it. And I must say that I loved it. The buffalo wings are really good and they make sweet potato tots that are to die for. The crab cake was nice but the dish that really set it off and my wife and I enjoyed the most was the fish tacos! Beer battered fish, crunchy topping and that sauce, mmmmm hmmmm! And let’s not forget the churros... phenomenal!

Typical dive bar/ sports bar in Mount Vernon with a Cheers vibe. Welcoming locals, where you leave feeling like you are part of the gang. Great happy hour specials and don't miss burger night on Wednesdays! The Guinness beer cheese is so good I just want to drink it. But I don't. I put it on my $6 burger and enjoy it in all its glorious messiness. The mac and cheese and broccoli are the perfect sides and worth the upcharge. Seriously. Broccoli. Yes. Get it. The pizza is a greasy, cheesy, heaven that will make you savor every bite. The crust is thicker so your toppings stay on the pizza, but thin enough to fold. They broadcast the games on small TVs at every table. But they are muted so they dont interrupt your conversations. Usually they've got good music playing in the background. They just started karaoke night on Fridays. Looking forward to giving that a shot.

A nice sport's bar with a surprisingly broad menu selection.  The chicken parmesan was EXCELLENT. A real chicken breast in a chunky tomato sauce.  Surprisingly good!!!
Service was great.

This place is a bit loud. Great to have drinks and catch up with friends or to watch the game. It is difficult to hear so I would not recommend for a date night.
customer_insights: Turp's Sports Bar & Restaurant is a casual, lively venue that offers a welcoming atmosphere for both locals and travelers. While the food quality can be hit or miss, the bar is known for its friendly service, fun happy hour specials, and a strong sense of community, making it a great spot for a night out with friends.

Friendly neighborhood pub.  Good chicken tenders, superb fries. No liquor, no draft beer. Great beer can list. Lots of local brews!

— Ali Hudler, Hudler Homes

address: 919 W 36th St, Baltimore, MD 21211, USA
googleReviews: Wings & drinks were good. Fast & friendly service. Pool tables available. Poor bouncers had to deal with a few young people that couldn't handle their liquor. The place could use some newer, sturdier chairs & better booths that are closer to the tables.

Checked this place out on a Saturday, on a whim. Atomsphere was little weird for me, with deer on the wall( old school). However, the food was delicious. Im a sucker for sweet potato fries, OMG. They must hand cut these like the regular  potato fries. Aaaamazing! Wings cooked to perfection. Slider Burgers was moist, overall very good. I will be back! Def for the sweet potato fries. 🫶🏽❤️

Good atmosphere for casual dining with cheap drink prices, however abominable service and inedible food.

Cons:  Service team is incompetent and will refuse to acknowledge you, seemingly to avoid doing work. I waited 15 minutes to place an order and another 30 for them to tell me they were missing ingredients for my meal, and then another 20 for my food to come out inedible; it was so dry I could crumble it to dusk in my fist.

I probably won’t be back, unless for a $3 drink, but hey, you get what you pay for.

Very cool spot, so much fascinating history on the walls with the signs, posters, concert flyers, instruments. Came early on a weekday so it was a local crowd. Gave it a nice “Cheers” vibe. Good selection of craft beer. Great service from the bartender. Definitely looking forward to coming back when I’m in the neighborhood.

We were in the neighborhood dropping off some donations to the Maryland SPCA. We stopped at Frazier's on the Avenue for lunch. Happily, it was a Thursday, half price burger day.

I've never eaten at Frazier's before. There's indoor and outdoor seating, and the decor is interesting. I've included pictures. The pictures show a nearly empty establishment, but we showed up at around 2:30 in the afternoon, between the lunch and dinner hours.

Our server was pleasant, informative, and efficient. The menu had lots of enticing items. Frazier's says their shrimp salad sandwich is famous so we split one of them. It was very good. We also split a Greek burger. That's a burger with feta cheese, spinach, tomato and tatziki sauce. I asked for medium rare, but I received a medium. Still, it was pretty good.

I recommend this Frazier's.

Stopped into Claddagh Pub in Canton for their Thursday $29 crab cake special and it was absolutely worth it. The plates came with two large crab cakes packed with lump crab meat and just the right amount of seasoning—no filler, just the real deal. The sides were hearty and flavorful; the mashed potatoes were creamy, the mac & cheese was cheesy and rich, and the Brussels sprouts were a great touch.

The portion sizes are generous, and you really feel like you’re getting a quality Maryland crab cake experience without the tourist-trap prices. Service was friendly, the food came out hot, and the atmosphere was classic Canton pub—laid-back but lively.

If you’re in Baltimore and want authentic, well-done crab cakes with a great neighborhood vibe, Claddagh is a must-try. I’ll definitely be back for the specials!

I’ve been coming to this place for a while now. This is my go to spot to watch any sporting events, whether it’s an NFL or a Premier League match. I know greatness when I see it…he is the real deal.  Cheers to you Kevin!
