Perfect spot for a casual lunch or dinner! Great food, very fair prices, and friendly service. Cool but cozy atmosphere. Good amount of outdoor seating (no smoking) with umbrellas. Clean bathrooms. In terms of accessibility, there are a few steps up into the restaurant. They have daily food & drink specials, which seem to be very popular; I had a phenomenal crab pretzel once. They also have $9 dine-in food specials Mon-Wed, which are hard to beat: Monday, burger or veggie burger; Tuesday, a pound of chicken wings; Wednesday, cheesesteak or chicken cheesesteak. They also have deals on wings & Boh during Ravens games and hot dogs & Boh during Orioles games. I’ve brought visiting friends & older family members here, and everyone has loved it. Highly recommend the wings (some of the best I’ve had anywhere), cheesesteaks, chicken Caesar wraps, club sandwiches, and crab pretzel when it’s available.
happy_hour_details: Daily food & drink specials; $9 dine-in specials Mon-Wed
customer_insights: 29th Street Tavern is a beloved local spot known for its casual atmosphere and affordable prices. Patrons rave about the wings and tater tots, making it a great choice for a relaxed evening out or a casual date night.

address: 801 S Decker Ave, Baltimore, MD 21224, USA
googleReviews: I hosted my birthday party here and couldn’t have asked for a better experience! The bar was packed on Wing Wednesday, but they reserved tables for my friends and me and made sure we were taken care of all night. Jocelyn was an amazing bartender, and the owners, Mike & Brice, jumped in whenever things got hectic — you can really tell they care about their place and their customers. They even went above and beyond by putting my name on the sign out front, which was such a fun surprise! It’s the little things like that that keep me coming back. The perfect neighborhood spot: fun, welcoming, and the kind of place where the owners aren’t “too good” to show their own faces. Highly recommend!

Stopped in for lunch with good friends who live locally. There is a very nice pub atmosphere here. The pub wasn't very crowded and the bartender acted as our server. The bartender was very attentive, checking in with us several times throughout the meal. I had a Monument City Brewing; American Brown Ale to start with which matched well with the meal. The Bangers and Mash were served with an excellent mustard-based homemade sauce. All said and done the food was great at a reasonable price with timely and attentive service. This is definitely a place to check out, if you haven't been yet.

If you're looking for a friendly, welcoming, inclusive atmosphere with great food, a robust beer selection, and a constant smile, look no further.

address: 1900 E Lombard St, Baltimore, MD 21231, USA
googleReviews: Love going to church ⛪️ now! Very unique & who would have thought of a brewery inside a church?! Glad they made such creative use of the space as it would've been torn down. Our bartenders Jack & Sara were so amazing!!!! If you're visiting or local, check this spot out!

Such a neatly repurposed use of an abandoned church - a massive labor of love! Beer was solid, and the to-go cans are a great value. Friendly bar staff. Plenty of space to stretch out. Sharp merchandise, too.

Ok, if you told me there was a brewery in a church in the middle of Baltimore I would have said you're a liar. Either way the beers are excellent and the the venue is is amazing! Just chilling in a church and drinking on a Tuesday. Best happy hour I could ask for.

Even though none of the beers really stood out to me, the atmosphere and staff did.  I'm always sucker for repurposed buildings and they did a good job with this one.  Beautiful architecture, lots of lighting, and good seating.

The staff was pretty friendly and offered a bunch of samples.  While none of the beers were ones I would get next time, they seemed like they mix it up enough and try enough to always get something new.

For being a brewery it was actually pretty family friendly as well and had a bunch of games tucked away as well.  I heard it also use to be dof friendly too but some guidelines made that change which is unfortunate.

Overall a good place to visit

Easily one of the coolest breweries I’ve ever been to. They have so much space because of how large the building is and the concept of renovating a church into a brewery is certainly creative. You could walk right past it on the street without knowing it’s a brewery. As for the interior, there’s plenty of seating options including different seat styles. They have a games corner where you can pick up card and board games as well as books and magazines to look through. I was a big fan of the “wispy” which is light and flavorful, but they have a lot of other good options to try. I was particularly impressed with their sours. If you’ve never been the beer flight is your best starting option!
customer_insights: Ministry of Brewing offers a unique experience by transforming a church into a brewery, creating a relaxed and creative atmosphere. Patrons appreciate the friendly staff, spacious seating, and the opportunity to enjoy a variety of beers, though some find the selections average. It's a great spot for casual gatherings, family-friendly outings, or pregame drinks.

Great beer great times! They have a great mix of spaces where they have a traditional tasting room, outside beer garden, pinball room, and best of all huge arcade room! They have pay and play with old school and new cabinets. this is a welcoming place that has a space for everyone.

My favorite brewery / place to hang out in the city! Great beer, great vibes, wonderful staff! I love how much of a community space it is – Peabody really supports and elevates other Baltimore small businesses and makers. There are fun events, live music, and of course, the arcade games!

You can bring your own food or games/activities, and my dog loves that she gets to come (and gets a treat at the bar)! I also love the outside space in the warmer months. There is always something for everyone. It is a perfect spot for everything from birthday celebrations to a casual happy hour.

So grateful to have such a fun and reliably fun spot in the neighborhood.

Even though I never had an issue until tonight I will never support y'all again. I have came to countless events over 15 years, which at this point was a complete waste of time.
Well the 5 foot woman with short black hair and a green streak was completely horrible.
One of my friend's was vending earlier and I came from PA to check if she was still there. I didn't see her so I sat facing the bar, reading beers. I am sure she and the other lady with orange hair saw me. I was like 'oh the Japanese rice beer' sounds good but I am not sure if I want a 16 oz. I walked up and waited to be helped. I asked to try it. There was one couple behind me and the other lady helped them. I walked down to the pour area following her and she walked back to the register ignoring me. I asked if they fill growlers she said no. I was going to ask about the pop up and the band at 8 but she acted like I was bothering her. I was like whatever as soon as I came back to the register, she said 'it's like you are trying beers are you going to get something.' I barely sipped the Japanese rice beer and placed the glass on the counter. I walked out.
I guess it does matter how you are dressed and look otherwise you will judged as someone not able to afford 10 beer. I guess an ACDC shirt and torn jeans don't cut it 🙄
I should not feel unwelcomed nor disrespected in a 'diverse' neighborhood. There is no excuse, individuals like her only have 'attitudes' when it's a solo carefree woman. If the guy with shoulder length hair helped me I'm sure I could have asked questions, enjoyed the 1 sip and opened a tap like I usually do with other beers on the list. Oh well, there are other breweries.
customer_insights: Peabody Heights Brewery is a vibrant community space in Baltimore known for its friendly atmosphere, diverse beer selection, and fun activities like arcade games and live music. While most patrons enjoy the welcoming vibe, there have been isolated complaints about service, suggesting a need for consistent staff training to maintain the positive experience.

address: 1611 Guilford Ave, Baltimore, MD 21202, USA
googleReviews: Joshua the manager and Joshua the bartender were amazing! We came from NYC, believing (and it’s true) that this is the only real brewery in town making beer on site. When we arrived, we discovered it was closed for a private wedding. Seeing how disappointed we were, Joshua the bartender, Joshua the manager, and the new chef kindly accommodated us so we could still enjoy their beer. They were so welcoming—and the beer was phenomenal! We heard the food is also incredible, so we’ll definitely be back to try it. Highly recommended—300%—to everyone in town!

I’ve waited 18 months and 8 visits before rating this place and posting this review. First of all, I’ve loved every beer I’ve had here - except for the one I had today, it was just okay.

The space is huge and the decor is great, this could be such a great European-style brewery complete with a Biergarten in the back. The food is also excellent, even if just a little pricey. The events? The events are great! They have fun events and educational events and community events. Again, there is a lot of space and that works well for many great events.

But sadly, the service is mediocre at best and negligent at worst. And it’s not even the servers themselves, I’ve had some great servers, but there has never been enough staff for the amount of patrons. In my opinion, the problem comes from the lack of identity of this place. Is it a restaurant with table service? Is it a brewery with counter service? It looks like a brewery but “attempts” to operate as a restaurant. Why have table service if you are going to have a single server/bar person for about 14 tables of 6 and 10 barstools? That’s a lot of people for a single server, no matter how great she is. And she was great today! She was working so hard and had a positive attitude.

I guess I’m hoping the owners read this and realize they need to staff this place better, with more people, and with better trained people. During my visits I’ve experienced the following: poorly trained servers who didn’t know how to operate the handheld Toast device; servers who disappeared for more than 15 minutes; food that didn’t show up for over 30 minutes and when I inquired the server had to go to the kitchen and ask only to find out they had ‘dropped the food and the plate broke so they had to remake it’ but failed to inform anyone about this mishap; hosts that ignored me as I was standing by the front door for a while; upstairs bar that was meant to be staffed during an event but no one showed up which left 2 servers attempting to serve more than 80 thirsty and hungry patrons.

This place has so much potential, and people still show up. And I’ll probably still come for the events they have or to meet with friends who live in the area, but I’ll just sit at the bar and hope that’s a better experience. This place could be so much better and I’m really sad that it’s not.

A solid 4 - liked it, but dinged by a few things. Pros: huge steins of traditional beer styles pair well with their flavorful German sausages; repurposed space is clean and relaxed. Cons: table service was lackluster for accuracy or speed; pricey versus comparable Baltimore brewpub spots.

My wife and I had lunch and attended a Law & Order spoof show at the Guilford Hall Brewery in Baltimore.

Street parking seemed to be the only parking available.

At first glance, the venue didn't seem to be wheelchair accessible because there was a short flight of stairs leading from the entry to the restaurant, but on your right, as you enter the front door, there's an elevator. And it's not one of those teeny afterthought elevators, it's a real, standard size elevator.

We split two appetizers, the Margherita flatbread appetizer and the supersize mozzarella cheese stick with marinara sauce. Both were delicious, and we didn't feel the need for any more food for lunch.

Service was friendly, but a bit slow. The show was one floor up, and we took the elevator.

We got married here last month, and I've got nothing but great things to say.

First, the food and drink were just stellar. We knew that we were in for a treat because of the tasting, but we had so many guests come up to us and say how delicious the food was. One of our neighbors here in Baltimore remarked on how he didn’t know about the brewery before but can’t wait to come back. My husband doesn’t drink, and rather than just having a soda/lemonade, José had a special non-alcoholic spritzer waiting just for him. Those little touches were so meaningful to us, and say a lot about how Guilford is thoughtful about the guest experience.

Despite being relatively new to the staff, Dani was incredibly helpful and very responsive in answering all of my numerous questions. When she wasn’t sure about the answer (for example, a very specific technical question about A/V equipment) she was able to point me to the right person who could assist. She also was gracious in allowing me to store a few items in the basement the night prior to the wedding so we didn’t have to carry so many things the day of. She was also very organized, including developing floor plans to make sure I liked them, checking placements, etc.
customer_insights: Guilford Hall Brewery is a spacious venue known for its on-site brewed beers and community events. While the food and drink offerings receive high praise, service has been noted as inconsistent, particularly during busy times. The brewery has a welcoming atmosphere, making it suitable for casual gatherings and events.

address: 1236 Light St 2nd floor, Baltimore, MD 21230, USA
googleReviews: Been in here a few times. Seems like there's always a small group of regulars cutting up and have fun with the bartenders. Really chill vibes & great food. Locked in as my favorite in FedHill after getting corned beef & cabbage special on St Paddys. Shockingly good. Best Ive had outside Boston. Did not expect this in Baltimore.

Best bar in South Baltimore! The crab crake sandwich and burgers are great. Excellent service as well with Ri and Geoffrey bartending. They have events every night and Saturday vinyl night is can’t miss!

This is a nice cosy bar and the bartender was super nice and friendly. The trivia on Thursday is fun but it’s mostly based on music and movies not much of general knowledge questions. The beers are great but sadly there’s no vegan options on the menu. Their website isn’t updated , the happy hour is from 3-6 and not 3-7 PM Monday- Friday and they no longer have the tacos or quesadillas on the menu.
What a great place! I went in for the record store and got go talk with the friendly staff and patrons and heard a great singer!

I rarely like the drinks i get from the bar because im picky. I dont like tasting the alcohol 😂 and i had an orange/pineapple crush here and it was DELICIOUS. Their jello shots are so good too!!! And bartender was very nice.
customer_insights: The Brewer's Cask is a cozy bar in South Baltimore known for its friendly atmosphere and engaging events like trivia and vinyl nights. Patrons appreciate the great food, particularly the crab cake sandwich and burgers, and the welcoming service from the bartenders.

venueName: Mystique Barrel Brewing and Lager House
address: 912 Washington Blvd, Baltimore, MD 21230, USA
googleReviews: Great selection of beers including a fine flemish red, a Marzen and a couple of tasty IPAs. There's a great food selection too. My rueben was thick and cheesy. The barkeep is cheerful and friendly. What more to ask?

I've lived a quarter of a mile away from this place since they opened and have never been until a few days ago.

Amazing pierogies and now they have loaded pierogies with corned beef, Monterey & Colby Jack cheese, sauerkraut and sour cream & chives!!

Great selection of beer and their hard seltzers are amazing as well.

If you're looking for an affordable spot that has great food and a great atmosphere then look no further.

10/10 spot, drive out of your way to go here!

Nice brewery in the Pigtown neighborhood of Baltimore. The beers were great, lots of different styles on tap- IPAs, a Belgian double, a few stouts, a Flanders Red, a lager, etc.
My favorite was the Erised Flanders Red Ale. At 8.5%, it had the perfect balance of sour, flavor, and boziness.
The food was also solid- they have a small kitchen with a pickup window. The Bratwurst was spot on and the Pretzel sticks were buttery with a soft crunch.
The server was friendly, as were the patrons.
Definitely make a brewery tour though Baltimore if you are in town, and be sure Mystique is on your list.

We stopped in here and we're really impressed with the types of beer they had on the menu. We also were surprised to see they have a kitchen in house and I though the food we had was pretty good as well. Our bartender was super nice and we appreciated talking with her during our visit. I look forward to seeing their next beer release.
Came in for a beer release. Nice assortment of brews, including some served at Camden Yards. Small and cozy.
customer_insights: Mystique Barrel Brewing and Lager House offers a welcoming atmosphere with a diverse selection of beers and hearty food options. Patrons appreciate the friendly service and the cozy environment, making it a great spot for casual gatherings or pregame meet-ups.

venueName: Charm City Meadworks @ Peabody Heights Brewery
address: 401 E 30th St, Baltimore, MD 21218, USA
googleReviews: All of their mead is really good! I loved every flavor I tried, I definitely recommend getting a flight. If you ask for a tour they will do a tour for your group at any time and tell you all about how they make their mead. They have some pizza too if you want some food. A fun brewery-like environment and great music. I wil definitely be back!
Great place to explore all the flavors of mead they make. Staff is helpful and will get you the perfect flavor. Nice outdoor patio to sit outside  and enjoy the drinks.

We showed up for trivia night and had a great time trying draft mead including a very dry basil lemongrass (delicate flavors) and a full on black currant (Currant Affairs) that reminded me of drinking Ribena as a child, They allow food from other places and have pizza on site. The large, open warehouse and artistic touches of bees adds to the bright and cherry atmosphere.

Cheers ! Great mead. If you don’t like wine or beer you might like mead ! Mead is honey wine and their options range from mildly sweet to very sweet. Definitely would recommend   Get the mango slushee !!!

I feel like a Skyrim character drinking mead

Some street parking. Real mead works. Tastings and tours. Buy a mead flight is 4 pours. Bring food, snacks, get Uber eats or delivery. Hang outside on the picnic tables, very sunny no umbrellas. Lawn games.
Inside No air. Tables and chairs. Good music. Nice staff.
customer_insights: Charm City Meadworks at Peabody Heights Brewery offers a vibrant atmosphere perfect for social gatherings. Guests enjoy a variety of mead flavors, outdoor seating, and the option to bring food from other places, making it a great spot for trivia nights and casual hangouts.

address: 1130 South Paca St, Baltimore, MD 21230, USA
googleReviews:
Pickett Brewing Company is such a fun and welcoming spot in Baltimore! The beers are creative, flavorful, and always brewed with care, you can tell the team here is passionate about what they do. The atmosphere is laid-back yet lively, making it perfect for catching up with friends or just enjoying a great pint. I love having local breweries like Pickett to share with clients who are moving into the area, it’s places like this that make Baltimore feel like home. 🍺✨

— Ali Hudler, Hudler Homes

Can't say enough good things about Pickett. Usually, going to breweries, I expect stouts, pale ales and maybe a few IPAS. But that's where Pickett stands out from the rest. They make their own seltzers (flavor combinations and all!) I was sitting at the bar counter one night when the owner was talking about flavors he was considering next. Lo and behold, a few weeks later, he made it, and it's amaaaazing! I love living close to here, the staff are all great, Tuna is perfect as usual, atmosphere is a great vibe, and prices are astounding. Love you Pickett!

Great brewery in Baltimore, a few blocks from Camden Yards. The beer was great- especially the Hazy New England IPAs. My favorites were the 33 1/3 Anchovy and the Moran Tribe Band.
They do not have flights, but they offer half pours.
If you have cat allergies, you may want to wait and visit on a nice day when they open the huge garage door. They have a working cat named Tuna who is on patrol at all times. He likes taking a seat on available laps, so be warned.
The brewery itself is well kept. Everything was clean, including the bathrooms.
Definitely visit Pickett if you are in the area for a ball game or just passing through (it's only a few minutes off 95).
Great beer and atmosphere! Captcrabby has some great food too! Come before and  after the Os and Ravens game.

One of the best spots in the city of Baltimore for beer,music and overall vibes!
Game days it’s a must visit!
And so many great events throughout the week!
Bluegrass jams and Bluegrass Sundays make Pickett the spot for music lovers!
customer_insights: Pickett Brewing Company is a vibrant and welcoming brewery in Baltimore, known for its creative and flavorful beers, including unique seltzer options. The laid-back atmosphere makes it an ideal spot for social gatherings, especially on game days or during special events like bluegrass jams.

address: 1700 W 41st St #420, Baltimore, MD 21211, USA
googleReviews: Union Craft delivers amazing service with a truly welcoming vibe. The space has a relaxed, upscale feel—one of the best spots in Brewers Hill. The staff goes above and beyond to make you feel at home, and the variety of drinks and food options is excellent. Whether you’re stopping in for a casual bite or a fun night out, this is hands down the best place to eat in the area.

Really awesome brewery with tons of seating space, great indoor-outdoor flow, and some surprisingly awesome food options. The pork belly sandwich and tater tots we had were fantastic and we also had two of their top selling beers. Lots of games and things inside to keep everyone entertained. This is a great option for all ages centrally located in the city.
Cool place with indoor and outdoor settings and creative lighting. Somewhat drab inside and could do more to cozy. Beers are good the rough draft scotch ale is tasty and wife loved the oatmeal stout

Stopped by to grab a few cold ones. There was plenty of seating inside and out. There was a good selection of beer available. A couple was sold out. All the brews we tried were well crafted and satisfying. It's definitely a good place to hang out.

We saw AJ Lee & Blue Summit at Union Craft Brewing. The staff were excellent. It's a great venue for music. It was a nice and diverse group. The food by Carroll and Son was good too. They have vegan and gluten free options.
customer_insights: Union Craft Brewing is a vibrant brewery in Baltimore known for its welcoming atmosphere and excellent service. It offers a variety of craft beers and food options, making it suitable for casual outings, family gatherings, and live music events.

address: 3626 Falls Rd, Baltimore, MD 21211, USA
googleReviews: Vegan burger and nacho fries, hits every time. So many options and rotating new choices. Everyone is nice, even the chefs coming out from the back! Fun spot for activities and watching games. Vegan NACHO CEESE. Ciders and drinks for my fellow GF people. Sometimes super busy.

Really enjoyed being here! The vibes were great (a little odd that 2/3+ of the tables were reserved, though). Relaxed and fun. Bartenders were super nice. Beer was fantastic. Food was great (we just tried the fries with the sauce flight). Lots of vegan options. I'll come back to try "real" food options and some of their cocktails/mocktails that looked great.
Absolutely incredible food. Unbelievable how good it is. The beer is fantastic, but I've never seen a brewery with better food. I wish I could give it more than 5 stars.

the amazing amount of vegan options caught our eye first! and as much as we would love to eat in our doggy was with us. so we got carry out, and it was all wonderfully prepared and packed. traveled soooo well was still nice and hot when we got home! amazing food amazing sauces

It should not even have the word cheesesteak in its name. It's more like a Korean sandwich that happens to have steak on it. It was good but a little on the salty side. The fries were great. I went on a Sunday afternoon, and the place was packed. I did manage to get one ot the last tables in the back corner! I was also surprised that the Coca-Cola was $4 per can.
customer_insights: Nepenthe Brewing Co. in Baltimore is a vibrant brewery known for its extensive vegan menu and friendly atmosphere. Guests rave about the quality of the food and beer, making it a popular spot for casual dining and social gatherings, especially for those seeking vegan options.

address: 1421 Ridgely St, Baltimore, MD 21230, USA
googleReviews: This place is great. Very spacious with beautiful interior design. The food is decent with a somewhat small menu. The selection of beer on tap and in a can are varied nicely. I love that you can put together your own 16 oz 4 pack for a slightly lower price than it would be for each can. Events that are happening here are definitely worth going to.

Checkerspot Brewing is such a standout in Baltimore! Their craft beers are always top-notch, creative, well-balanced, and full of flavor. The atmosphere is welcoming and friendly, and you can feel the passion the team puts into every detail. Whether you’re a longtime local or new to the city, this is the perfect spot to relax, try something new, and enjoy the community vibe. As a realtor, I love pointing clients to Checkerspot as one of the must-visit breweries that make Baltimore so special. 🍻🌟

— Ali Hudler, Hudler Homes
IMO. My favorite brewery. Hillbilly Gold is a crisp Pilsner. Perfect on a warm day. All of the beer tenders are very nice. 5 stars.

Checkerspot Brewing should not be marketing a beer that explicitly makes fun of millions of Americans who trace their heritage to the Southern/Appalachian region.  The term “Hillbilly” has long been identified as a derogatory term used to promote untrue stereotypes about Southern/Appalachian people.   Imagine if the company promoted a beer with similarly offensive imagery about Jewish, black or Latino Americans.  The company should cease all promotions and sales of this product.  For more information on why such imagery is so offensive, see Billings, Dwight B.; Norman, Gurney; Ledford, Katherine (2000). Back Talk from Appalachia: Confronting Stereotypes. University Press of Kentucky. ISBN 978-0813143347.  31 July 2014.

This place has always been awesome. We have been coming here for years at the old location and the new location is really cool. It has easily accessible parking for free across the street. They serve a rotating beer menu, along with some food options. They have events from time to time. The best part is they are dog friendly outside and indoors. All of the staff are super accommodating. They also have a variety of pinball machines to play upstairs. This is an awesome spot to pregame before Ravens games or top golf because it is walking distance to the stadium and the range.
budget_friendly_items: 16 oz 4 pack of beer at a lower price
customer_insights: Checkerspot Brewing Company is a beloved brewery in Baltimore known for its spacious and inviting atmosphere. Customers appreciate the variety of craft beers and the community vibe, making it a great spot for pregame gatherings and casual nights out.

address: 5001 Washington Blvd, Halethorpe, MD 21227, USA
googleReviews:
Great facility with many options! Indoor or outdoor seating; comfy barstool at the large rectangular bar or chair at a table; high table or regular height; picnic table or cozy patio around a fire pit. You choose and this isn't even all the options available...
The menu offers a good selection of various cultural- and American-style foods as appetizers, entrees, etc. The beer is really excellent -- staff was happy to guide you to your best personal taste in beers and let you sample to see what appeals most.
There is a gift shop with cool momentos and select your own four-pack, or fill a growler or large can with your favorite. Tours are also available. Our food was tasty and arrived quickly after our order was placed.

An excellent place even if you aren’t a Guinness fan (though I doubt you’ll leave without being one). Took a tour rooted in history that also touched on the brewing process. Our tour guide was awesome & a sheer delight! The food is delicious though very hearty so don’t be afraid to have a few drinks from the tap beforehand as the food will definitely sober you up.

Guinness Open Gate Baltimore is Disney World for beer drinkers!  We visited last year for the first time and couldn't wait to visit again. This trip was planned specifically to take the History Tour & tasting. Pip was a fantastic tour guide! They made it informative & entertaining. The entire experience was everything we hoped for & more. The variety of beer & food is wonderful. Get the Smith Island Cake. Seriously, Best. Cake. Ever.

This place is one of my favorite places in the greater Baltimore area. The brewery is huge, with plenty of indoor and outdoor seating. Whether you’re sitting at the bar for a pint and a snack or sitting down at a table for a meal, you’ll have a great time. The interior is your classic industrial brewery with a bunch of fun Guinness signs and memorabilia. It seemed like there were tons of staff working so our food and drinks arrived quickly. If you sit inside in the taproom they have $40 for 4 sliders and 4 pints of Guinness Draught which is a great deal if you’re visiting with a couple friends! It’s conveniently located right off of Route 1, it sits by itself but it’s easy enough to hop right onto the highway and head into the city or over to another town. They seem to have a variety of fun events throughout the year whether it’s trivia night, football Sunday, Oktoberfest, etc, you name it. They also have several different brewery tours that run most days of the week. Definitely worth a visit!

OMG! The Guinness Brewery Gate in Baltimore is a one-of-a-kind brewery that every beer lover should visit. The food quality, quantity, and taste are unbelievably good. It’s a huge place with plenty of seating and parking. I can only imagine how great it must be in the summer, but even when I went in November, it was fully crowded.
First of all, the organization, service, and the accuracy with which they bring food to your table are fantastic. I am a vegetarian, and initially I thought I wouldn’t find any veggie burgers or vegetarian options, but the black bean burger with fries was incredibly tasty. Whenever I go to Baltimore, this will be a must-visit place for me.
budget_friendly_items: $40 for 4 sliders and 4 pints of Guinness Draught
customer_insights: Guinness Open Gate Brewery in Baltimore offers a vibrant atmosphere with a wide selection of beers and hearty American and Irish cuisine. It's a perfect spot for groups looking to enjoy a lively night out, with options for both indoor and outdoor seating.

address: 1 N Haven St, Baltimore, MD 21224, USA
googleReviews: Really cool brewery! Their prices are very solid for the tasty beers they have on tap, the staff are friendly, atmosphere is relaxed, and the beers are great. Cant go wrong here, 10/10 would recommend!

We recently had our wedding at Monument City Brewing, and it was nothing short of perfect! The space was beautiful, the atmosphere warm and welcoming, and the team went above and beyond to make our day feel special and seamless.

A huge thank you to Ken and his wife Kim for being so incredibly supportive and accommodating throughout the planning process and on the day itself.

We also can’t say enough good things about the amazing bartenders, Jen and Tracy. They were awesome, friendly and so helpful.

If you're looking for a beautiful, and well-run venue for your event—or just want to enjoy great beer in a great space—Monument City Brewing is the place to go. We are so grateful and will cherish the memories made here forever! 🍻💛

Great ambiance, friendly and fast service. This is a dog friendly Brewery. There is plenty of off-street parking available for free. Beer tended to be average to above average. They have some high ABV beers too. Their best beer is their dessert Stout called Bulls-Eye. It's absolutely divine!

This is definitely more of a chill environment here. It's family friendly and the crowd is a nice mix of young to older.

Take a look at the amazing doors when you come in.

My partner and I recently hosted our wedding reception at Monument City Brewing Company and they were fantastic to work with! If you're looking for a beautiful, convenient space to host a private event with very reasonable and flexible terms, check them out.

Went here on a Saturday and it was packed!! Really great beer but sometimes had to wait in a 15 minute line to get it. I liked the 51 Rye with Apricot & Battle IPA with Mango. Will definitely be back though, they have some fun events on certain nights like bingo and live music, there was a food truck there for anyone who wanted food as well.
customer_insights: Monument City Brewing Company offers a relaxed and friendly atmosphere, making it an excellent choice for casual gatherings, family outings, and even private events like weddings. With a variety of beers on tap and occasional events like bingo and live music, it caters to a diverse crowd, ensuring a good time for all.

address: 1215 E Fort Ave #008, Baltimore, MD 21230, USA
googleReviews:
Great pizza, beer and service! Appreciate the staff turning on the outdoor heaters for us.

We tried the Jersey pizza and Margarita pizza with pepperoni and jalapeños as add-ons (extra charge). Our beer of choices were the Lager and their Peach Cobbler Sour. Everything was great.

Fresh delicious pizza. With extremely fast efficient service. The vibe is laid back and funky. There is a large outdoor seating area, with suffient cozy hightop seating inside. We'll definitely be back.

Diamondback Beer is one of my favorite spots in Locust Point! The atmosphere is always welcoming, the team is friendly, and the beer selection never disappoints, there’s truly something for everyone. I love that it’s not just a brewery, but also a great place to gather with friends or meet new people in the community. Their space has such a relaxed, neighborhood feel, and it’s one of the local gems I’m always proud to recommend to clients moving into the area. 🍻✨

— Ali Hudler, Hudler Homes

The place was nice. A little hard to find though. The beer was good, not great. The food options are limited pretty much  to pizza and salad. The pizza was decent but nothing to write home about the salad in my opinion was better.  I also heard you can order pepperoni pizza which is not on the menu.

The staff is lovely. The beer is very good and different selections rotate in fairly often. Their pizza crust has perfect chew and the Jersey pie (in house vodka sauce) with meatballs IMO is to die for. The salad is also great. One of my fav breweries in Baltimore.
customer_insights: Diamondback Brewing Company in Locust Point is a beloved local brewery known for its laid-back atmosphere and friendly staff. Guests enjoy a rotating selection of beers and a focused menu primarily featuring pizza, making it a great spot for casual gatherings with friends or pregame outings.

address: 1700 W 41st St, Baltimore, MD 21211, USA
googleReviews: This area has several businesses collaborating together. There is something for everyone! You union brewery that serves awesome pizza! There wine place and spirits place which serves unique named beverages which they make themselves. The had gin flight which was great for the price! Definitely would go there again. The wine place serves food which you need to make reservations ahead of time since they're usually busy.

A great atmosphere with awesome beer and fun staff. The food is a little pricey but good. There is a huge variety of beer and ciders on tap, bottles, and cans. They also have a cute photo booth in the trailer that they have in the room. There is plenty of space and it wasn't too crowded. Would love to go back next time I'm around the Baltimore area.

The Wine Collective located in the Union Collective in Baltimore City...a refreshing getaway on a Tuesday evening, listening to fresh, original, enticing jazz, (Jack Gussio jazz group is a must hear) while sipping some extraordinary wines  (peregrine, wizard, and pinot gris) is the way to spend your evening...and if you're lucky, your favorite love will ask you to walk around the corner to see the holiday lights on 34th Street in Baltimore City.

This is THE spot to go for a great night of varied drinks and snacks! Went with friends on black Friday and hit up Union Brewing, The Cocktail Gallery, and The Wine Collective! All of the drinks were amazing, and the food at The Wine Collective was exactly what exactly needed after a night of drinks.

This is a great place to have a few craft beers. The eatery doesn't have huge variety, but it is good food if small portions for the price. Inflation I guess. If you are coming here to talk it is a bit loud. There is outside seating, but not the most pleasant on a hot day. The novelties vending machine was fun.
customer_insights: Union Collective in Baltimore offers a vibrant atmosphere with a variety of craft beers, wines, and unique cocktails. It's a great spot for social gatherings, with options for food and live music, making it suitable for pregaming and casual nights out.

address: 1100 Wicomico St, Baltimore, MD 21230, USA
googleReviews: I love this spot so much!!! The vibe is welcoming and fun with all the pinball machines and the tailgates they host for the Ravens games. Even if you’re not a football fan, there’s something for everyone! I appreciate how community-oriented they are with events and local collabs. And of course, the beer is amazing and creative.

Wico is an absolute gem—excellent beers, amazing food, and a vibe that hits just right. It’s dog friendly, the staff makes you feel instantly at home, and the pinball machines plus occasional live music add to the experience. This place truly stands out. Highly recommend stopping in and experiencing this brewery for yourself!

Really good brewery tucked away in pigtown! Their selection has all types of beers(hazy,amber,maibock,sours,lagers) and even craft seltzer on tap with added flavors for the NA folx!
A nice selection of newer, well maintained pinball machines and a bunch of boardgames and sometimes a N64. Would recommend if you're looking for a chill vibe in the area. Bring your own food, or dog!
The best guys, great beer, great food! Perfect game day spot!! 12 minute skip to ravens walk! Awesome for events too, lively space, fun events! Def worth checking out

Loved our experience. The bartenders are super nice, and the beer is delightful. I especially enjoyed the sour. The seating was comfortable. We would return just for their pup alone - she was a very good girl. They have a wide array of pinball machines and board games. And I was impressed at how many events they do, from corn hole to paint and sip events. We'll definitely be back.
customer_insights: Wico Street Beer Co is a vibrant brewery in Baltimore known for its welcoming atmosphere, excellent beer selection, and community-focused events. With fun activities like pinball machines and live music, it’s a great spot for both casual hangouts and game day celebrations.

address: 4015 Foster Ave #400, Baltimore, MD 21224, USA
googleReviews: Had a great experience at Mobtown last month for the Breaking Bradish premier. The IPA itself was very good. Good balance of flavor and it went down smoothly. Interior design with the murals is really cool. Plus the opportunity they provided that night to let us meet some of the Baltimore Orioles, including Kyle Bradish himself, was amazing. Loved taking home a signed Breaking Bradish can! That means a lot to me, a die-hard Orioles fan. Glad I was able to take a four-pack of the Breaking Bradish home, and I'd love to come back sometime next season to try some more beer before an Orioles game!

I hosted my sister’s bridal shower here and it was absolutely fantastic. Everyone I dealt with was friendly. They were very easy going and accommodating and most importantly the beer and drinks were delicious. I strongly recommend visiting this spot and considering it for your next event!

One of the best breweries in Baltimore! They have a great selection of different brews and every one is worth a try. I'm always excited when they announce a new beer because they never miss the mark. They host great events and have great food truck during the weekends. Service is always friendly and helpful. If your looking for good beer look no further!

Roomy industrial-style brewery with plenty of seating, plus fun colorful artwork and murals on the walls. Nice draft list, I like their IPAs the best. Friendly staff. The couple times I’ve been here I’ve found street parking fairly easily just a couple blocks away. They are also dog friendly, there were lots of well-behaved pups hanging around!

Good beer. One Two Punch is a strong triple IPA. A bit on the sweeter side but not cloyingly so. Their Baltic Porter is on point with just a hint of chocolate. Was not a fan of their white barrel aged stout. A little after taste on the back end did not mesh with my pallet. But the imperial was not bad. I am looking forward to trying their hazy IPA's, and their Belgium Quad. Very eclectic place I would highly recommended it. Parking will be a challenge though.
customer_insights: Mobtown Brewing Company is a lively brewery in Baltimore known for its great selection of craft beers and friendly atmosphere. It hosts various events, making it a popular spot for gatherings and celebrations, while also being dog-friendly.

address: 1 N Haven St, Baltimore, MD 21224, USA
googleReviews:
Chill little brewery out on one of the old industrial peninsulas in Dundalk. We like their beer and their little popcorn machine which was a great idea for a brewery. They have shuffleboard darts and board games.
I like their imperial stout which packed a punch, but also the all days off. Lager had solid flavor. Nothing crazy about it.
I also have an eagle cam which is a camera overlooking an eagle's nest that isn't above the parking lot. Pretty cool to watch the birds.
Excellent beer and a really nice pleasant atmosphere.  Chelsea our bartender was fantastic!  We will definitely return!

We hosted private event at the brewery.  The atmosphere was friendly.   Dillion, Joe  and staff were cordial and very flexible with arrangements.  Thank you.  I'll be back!    Oh yes.......the beer was good too!

Delicious addition to the area. Nice open venue with free pool, free pinball, and a couple TVs. There was a food truck outside when we visited, but not the previous time. The bar offers flights of any quantity, 10oz and 16oz pours, and growler fills.

Good beers on draft-classic lager, stout (non-coconut), and rose' seltzer. I love their Undertow gose'! ONLY tasting room with LIVE osprey cam which displays local nest in their parking lot!! We'll be back!🪹🪶🍻
customer_insights: Key Brewing Co. offers a relaxed atmosphere with a variety of games and a unique eagle cam, making it a fun spot for casual gatherings. The brewery is well-received for its solid beer selection and friendly staff, making it a great place for groups looking to unwind.

address: 1399 S Sharp St, Baltimore, MD 21230, USA
googleReviews: Minor negatives: staff really had no idea what they were doing 😅, and it's a giant location basically under a bridge. Positives: sleek, high-investment brewery, with a range of food and beer options near the stadium. Appreciated the Australian/New Zealand hop focus. Excellent merch.

M8 Beer is definitely worth a stop if you’re looking to try some interesting brews in a laid-back setting. The atmosphere was spacious, clean, and had a good energy without being too loud—perfect for a casual drink or hangout. There were 4 TVs near the bar playing sports, which added to the relaxed, social vibe.

The staff was super friendly and welcoming, offering samples and answering questions without pressure. I appreciated being able to try 5 oz pours, which made it easy to sample a few beers without committing to a full pint.

I came to check out the beer specifically and really enjoyed the Morning Mugs collab—a smooth coffee milk stout that was flavorful without being too heavy. I also tried the Outback, which was another solid choice. Attached a beer menu photos for other options.

Although I didn’t get to try the food, the menu looked great and reasonably priced (attached for reference). I’ll definitely be back—whether it’s for more beer or to check out the food next time. Great spot overall!

Family friendly place with great food and great beer as well as a stellar cocktail menu paying homage to Australia and using some spirits from down under. Upstairs bar was set up for a ticketed trivia event. Menu had tasty fried pickles and a tasty falafel burger for this vegetarian. 🙂

First brewery of our trip and it didn’t disappoint! Staff was super friendly and my cousin had a great time exploring more of Baltimore. Figured it was an Australian inspired brewery too
Good hidden message lol 😎🍻

M8 Brewery – A Hidden Gem in Baltimore
We stopped by M8 Brewery on a whim while exploring the Ravens Stadium neighborhood, and what a great find it turned out to be! The atmosphere was warm and relaxed — the perfect spot to grab a craft beer and soak in some local vibes.
We sat at the bar, enjoyed a couple of great brews, and chatted with the friendly staff. A gentleman sat nearby and struck up an easy conversation with us — humble, down-to-earth, and clearly passionate about the place. It wasn’t until after he left that the bartender mentioned he was actually the owner! That kind of humility says a lot about the character of this place.
The beer was excellent, the service was genuine, and the overall experience was memorable. Whether you’re a local or just passing through, M8 Brewery is absolutely worth a stop — great people, great beer, and great energy.
customer_insights: M8 Beer is a spacious and relaxed brewery perfect for casual hangouts, offering a variety of craft beers and a friendly atmosphere. With a focus on Australian and New Zealand hops, patrons appreciate the unique brews and welcoming staff, making it a great spot for both locals and visitors.

address: 8251 Telegraph Rd Suite D, Odenton, MD 21113, USA
googleReviews:
Don't let this location fool you!!! There's not a ton going on outside but it's inside where you wanna be anyways!  The sours and beers are fantastic.  They have mead, I'm not a mead guy, so idk but choices are awesome.

There's a brick oven!!!!

You owe yourself to come here. It's so great.

They have an excellent selection of beer with consistent, cute art. It seems they rotate about 2 taps every few weeks, so there is a lot of variety. They also sell mead from a nearby meadery. They have a kitchen in-house that makes excellent thin crust pizza, along with things like pretzels, wings, and deserts. The trivia every Wednesday is a good level of difficulty and lasts about 2 hours.
Great beer selection with feisty pop culture names and eye grabbing art. Food is also decent! We'll be back!

I love a good pizza place, especially one that uses a brick oven. I had heard of their beer, but didn't know they had a pizza joint until my office went there for a business lunch. You order at the table using a QR code, which makes the process quick. Plenty of seating for smaller groups, but a little harder for bigger groups depending on the date and time. It took a bit to get a drink because there were quite a few people in line to order, but everyone working there was very friendly and accommodating. The food was fantastic and I've been looking forward to my next trip. You will not be disappointed in the food. I recommend this place!

It's such an awesome place. You walked in, and you could smell the food, which smelled fantastic. Huge variety of beers. They brew all the beers there. You can actually see where they brew them. I highly recommend this brewery.
customer_insights: Crooked Crab Brewing Company is a vibrant brewery in Baltimore known for its fantastic selection of craft beers and delicious brick oven pizzas. The atmosphere is lively and casual, making it a great spot for groups or a fun night out, with trivia nights adding to the entertainment.

address: 1625 Union Ave Suite C, Baltimore, MD 21211, USA
googleReviews: Waverly Brewing is unlike most breweries you might visit. It's got small neighborhood bar charm, great owners and staff who loving working with their community & city. Lots of fun events and you can't beat the vibes!  Almost forgot... the beers great too!

Waverly makes great craft beer and their tasting room is a great hang out spot. They have more than a dozen beers on tap. They also have wine, which is wonderful, as my wife doesn't drink beer.
Staff is friendly and attentive. Definitely will head back there next time I'm in the area.

Rerouted from Union to try out waverly per a friends request and it did not disappoint! Hole in the wall speakeasy meets dive bar meets brewery! Low key vibes, rustic basement feel! This isnt for beer snobs but instead for those who want to sip and chill. LOVE LOVE LOVE Mel! Will definitely be back!

This place is awesome! Excellent beer. Excellent atmosphere. Chatted with Mel- and she’s honestly one of the best humans. If you are looking for a family friendly and inclusive (ie. very queer friendly) place to enjoy local brews- look no further.

Loved the beer here! They have a great variety of options, and some ciders as well. I loved the Pilsner and the Blonde Ale. They don’t have their own food but have rotating food from other restaurants available (it was sandwiches and salad this weekend). There is plenty of space and a brewing room that has tables as well. They have cornhole and seating outside for when it’s warm. Will definitely be back!
customer_insights: Waverly Brewing Company is a beloved local brewery known for its friendly atmosphere and community involvement. With a diverse selection of craft beers and a welcoming vibe, it's perfect for casual hangouts, friendly gatherings, and even first dates.

address: 4615 Hollins Ferry Rd # A, Halethorpe, MD 21227, USA
googleReviews: Been visiting from Germany, doing a brewery tour (among other things) in Baltimore. It’s not easy to get there if you don’t have a car and are in Baltimore city-proper, but def worth it! Great beers, super-friendly and helpful folks there and the place as such is awesome. You can play games like cornhole while enjoying your beers. Also cool merch and there’s a nice bbq-foodtruck there! By any chance - don’t miss it!!
Super friendly staff, delicious brews, great decor, and chill music playlists 😌 Nearly everyone in the brewery had ordered flights because there’s so many tasty options to choose from 😋

Great local brewery with a long history.  The tap room is pretty nice, and they have a good bit of outdoor seating.  Loose Cannon IPA is a staple and always a good choice.  My other favorites are Double Cannon and Hazy Cannon.  They have a wide selection of beer, including seasonal beers, so I'm sure you'll find one you like.

Quick stop with our dogs for a beer and lunch. Food from the Pit Stop was great - pork BBQ sandwich and brat sandwich - plus a couple of Bodacious Blondes.

It was busy when we arrived at noon on Saturday and packed when we left at 1:30.  We opted to sit on the deck but one of the owners came out and told us dogs were welcome inside. We thanked him and said we were taking advantage of the nice weather to sit outside.

Bartenders were spot on, food was great as was the beer.

My family and I took the tour and it was very informative. The gentleman who gave it, sorry I forgot his name, was awesome. Even though it was very hot, he made it fun. We then proceeded to relax in the bar area for a few hours. Of course, my family enjoyed the beer selection. Many of which you can only get there. I'm a recovering alcoholic, so I had root beer which was quite tasty. The food truck was also, good. We are definitely going back soon.
customer_insights: Heavy Seas Beer is a lively brewery known for its friendly atmosphere and a wide selection of craft beers. Visitors enjoy the outdoor seating and food truck offerings, making it a great spot for casual gatherings with friends or family.
